```{r}
get_loaded_packages <- function(file_path) {
  
  
  # Read the script file line by line
  lines <- readLines(file_path)[1:200]
  

  
  
  # Define a regex pattern for library() or require() calls.
  # This pattern handles optional whitespace and optional quotes.
  pattern <- "(?:library|require)\\s*\\(\\s*['\"]?([a-zA-Z0-9\\.]+)['\"]?\\s*\\)"
  
  # Find lines that match the pattern
  
  
  pkg_calls <- grep(pattern, lines, value = TRUE)
  
  # Extract the package name (the first captured group)
  pkg_names <- sub(pattern, "\\1", pkg_calls)
  
  # Return unique package names
  unique(pkg_names)
}

# Example usage:
loaded_pkgs <- get_loaded_packages("code/main.Rmd")


bib <- sapply(loaded_pkgs, function(pkg) toBibtex(citation(pkg)))


add_pkg_keys <- function(bib_list) {
  out <- bib_list

  for (pkg in names(out)) {
    x <- out[[pkg]]

    # Make sure we have one single string to work with
    if (inherits(x, "bibentry")) x <- toBibtex(x)
    x <- paste(as.character(x), collapse = "\n")

    # Find occurrences like "@Type{," (allowing whitespace)
    m <- gregexpr("@[A-Za-z]+\\s*\\{\\s*,", x, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (m[1] == -1) {
      out[[pkg]] <- x
      next
    }

    matches <- regmatches(x, list(m))[[1]]

    reps <- matches
    for (i in seq_along(matches)) {
      key <- if (length(matches) == 1) pkg else paste0(pkg, i)
      reps[i] <- sub("\\{\\s*,", paste0("{", key, ","), matches[i], perl = TRUE)
    }

    regmatches(x, list(m)) <- list(reps)
    out[[pkg]] <- x
  }

  out
}



bib_fixed <- add_pkg_keys(bib)  # bib is your named list

nice_colors <- function(n){
  light <- scales::hue_pal(h.start = 60, c = 120, l = 70)(n)
  dark <-  scales::hue_pal(h.start = 60, c = 120, l = 40)(n)
  nice <- c()
  for (i in 1:n) {
    if(i%%2 == 0){ 
      nice[i] <- light[i]
    }
    else{
      nice[i] <- dark[i]
    }
    
  }
  
  return(nice)
}
```

```{r}
refactor_names <- function(df){
  
  if ("End Path" %in% names(df)){
      names(df)[which(names(df) == "End Path")] <- "path"
  }
  else {
      names(df)[which(names(df) == "Begin Path")] <- "path"
  }
  

  

  
  names(df)[which(names(df) == "End.File")] <- "name"
  
  names(df)[which(names(df) == "End File")] <- "name"
  
  names(df)[which(names(df) == "Begin File")] <- "name"
  
  names(df)[which(names(df) == "Begin.File")] <- "name"
  
  names(df)[which(names(df) == "Begin.Time..s.")] <- "begin"
  
  names(df)[which(names(df) == "Begin Time (s)")] <- "begin"
  
  names(df)[which(names(df) == "End.Time..s.")] <- "end"
  
  names(df)[which(names(df) == "End Time (s)")] <- "end"
  
  return(df)
  
}
```

# syllable edit distance similarity
```{r}




## ---- Setup helpers ------------------------------------------------------

# Winsorize a numeric vector to percentile cutoffs
winsorize <- function(x, probs = c(0.01, 0.99)) {
  q <- stats::quantile(x, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  x[x < q[1]] <- q[1]
  x[x > q[2]] <- q[2]
  x
}

# Robust z-score using median/MAD (consistent with ~N(0,1))
robust_scale <- function(x) {
  med <- stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad <- stats::mad(x, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)  # 1.4826 for consistency
  if (mad == 0 || is.na(mad)) mad <- stats::IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE) / 1.349
  if (mad == 0 || is.na(mad)) mad <- 1
  (x - med) / mad
}

# Safe log transform (for positive, right-skewed features)
safe_log <- function(x, eps = NULL) {
  if (is.null(eps)) eps <- max(1e-6, 0.01 * stats::quantile(x[x > 0], 0.01, na.rm = TRUE))
  log(pmax(x, eps))
}



# Clip to (ε, 1-ε)
clip01 <- function(x, eps = 1e-6) pmin(1 - eps, pmax(eps, x))

neglog1m <- function(x, eps = 1e-6) {   # best for mass near 1
  -log(1 - clip01(x, eps))
}

logit <- function(x, eps = 1e-6) {
  xx <- clip01(x, eps)
  log(xx / (1 - xx))
}



## ---- Main preprocessing -------------------------------------------------

# syllables_mean: your data frame (one row per syllable instance)
# feature_cols: character vector of column names with numeric features to compare
# log_cols: subset of feature_cols to log-transform (e.g., c("duration","bandwidth"))
preprocess_features <- function(syllables_mean, feature_cols, log_cols = NULL,
                                logit_cols = NULL, neglog1_cols = NULL,
                                winsor_probs = c(0.01, 0.99)) {
  X <- syllables_mean[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE]
  
  # 0) Basic NA handling (impute with feature median)
  for (k in seq_along(feature_cols)) {
    col <- feature_cols[k]
    if (anyNA(X[[col]])) {
      med <- stats::median(X[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      X[[col]][is.na(X[[col]])] <- med
    }
  }
  
  # 1) Optional log for skewed features
  if (!is.null(log_cols) && length(log_cols)) {
    for (col in intersect(log_cols, feature_cols)) {
      X[[col]] <- safe_log(X[[col]])
    }
  }
  
  # 1) Optional logit for restricted features
  if (!is.null(logit_cols) && length(logit_cols)) {
    for (col in intersect(logit_cols, feature_cols)) {
      X[[col]] <- logit(X[[col]])
    }
  }
  
  # 1) Optional logit for restricted features
  if (!is.null(neglog1_cols) && length(neglog1_cols)) {
    for (col in intersect(neglog1_cols, feature_cols)) {
      X[[col]] <- neglog1m(X[[col]])
    }
  }
  
  # 2) Winsorize extremes per feature
  for (col in feature_cols) {
    X[[col]] <- winsorize(X[[col]], winsor_probs)
  }
  
  # 3) Robust standardization per feature
  for (col in feature_cols) {
    X[[col]] <- robust_scale(X[[col]])
  }
  
  as.matrix(X)
}

## ---- Shrinkage covariance & pairwise Mahalanobis -----------------------

# Uses corpcor::cov.shrink for stable inverse when features are correlated
pairwise_mahalanobis <- function(X) {
  if (!requireNamespace("corpcor", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Please install 'corpcor' for cov.shrink: install.packages('corpcor')")
  }
  S <- corpcor::cov.shrink(X)     # p x p
  iS <- solve(S)                  # p x p (stable due to shrinkage)
  
  # Pairwise squared Mahalanobis via Gram trick:
  # d^2(i,j) = (x_i iS x_i^T) + (x_j iS x_j^T) - 2 x_i iS x_j^T
  G  <- X %*% iS %*% t(X)         # n x n
  d2 <- outer(diag(G), diag(G), "+") - 2 * G
  d  <- sqrt(pmax(d2, 0))         # numerical safety
  d
}

# Optional: map raw distances to a bounded scale to temper huge costs
bounded_transform <- function(d, c = NULL) {
  if (is.null(c)) c <- stats::median(d[d > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  d / (d + c)  # in (0,1); 0≈identical, 0.5 when d=c
}

## ---- Build substitution matrix + gap penalties -------------------------

# Returns:
#   list(dist_matrix, gap_open, gap_extend)
# where dist_matrix is n_syllables x n_syllables aligned to row order of syllables_mean
build_syllable_distance <- function(syllables_mean,
                                    feature_cols,
                                    log_cols = NULL,
                                    logit_cols = NULL,
                                    neglog1_cols = NULL,
                                    winsor_probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
                                    transform_to_bounded = TRUE) {
  
  X <- preprocess_features(syllables_mean,
                           feature_cols,
                           log_cols,
                           logit_cols,
                           neglog1_cols,
                           winsor_probs)
  D <- pairwise_mahalanobis(X)
  
  if (transform_to_bounded) {
    D <- bounded_transform(D)  # keeps values in (0,1)
  }
  
  # Suggest gap penalties from distribution of distances
  # median ~ "typical substitution"; use a fraction for extend
  typical <- stats::median(D[upper.tri(D)], na.rm = TRUE)
  gap_open   <- typical
  gap_extend <- 0.25 * gap_open
  
  list(dist_matrix = D, gap_open = gap_open, gap_extend = gap_extend)
}

amp_col <- "r_rms_amp"

gap_scale <- .5

dwed <- function(a, b) {
  
  # indices of syllables belonging to each song (assumes rows are individual syllables)
  s1 <- which(syllables_mean$name == a)
  s2 <- which(syllables_mean$name == b)
  m  <- length(s1); n <- length(s2)
  if (m == 0 || n == 0) stop("One of the songs has zero syllables.")
  
  # amplitude weights (normalize to median to keep magnitudes sane)
  amp <- syllables_mean[[amp_col]]
  w1 <- amp[s1]  # weights for deletions (gaps in b)
  w2 <- amp[s2]  # weights for insertions (gaps in a)
  
  avg_len <- mean(table(syllables_mean$name))  # dataset-wide average
  w1 <- w1 * (length(w1) / avg_len)
  w2 <- w2 * (length(w2) / avg_len)
  
  # gap defaults if not provided
  if (is.null(gap_open) || is.null(gap_extend)) {
    typical <- stats::median(syllable_distance_matrix[upper.tri(syllable_distance_matrix)], na.rm = TRUE)
    gap_open   <- typical
    gap_extend <- 0.2 * gap_open
  }
  
  # DP matrix
  d <- matrix(0, nrow = m + 1, ncol = n + 1)
  
  # Init: cost to delete/insert prefixes (linear gap with open+extend for simplicity)
  d[1, 1] <- 0
  for (i in 2:(m + 1)) {
    # delete syllable i-1 from song a
    d[i, 1] <- d[i - 1, 1] + gap_scale * (gap_open + gap_extend * w1[i - 1])
  }
  for (j in 2:(n + 1)) {
    # insert syllable j-1 from song b
    d[1, j] <- d[1, j - 1] + gap_scale * (gap_open + gap_extend * w2[j - 1])
  }
  
  # Fill
  for (i in 2:(m + 1)) {
    for (j in 2:(n + 1)) {
      wi <- w1[i - 1]; wj <- w2[j - 1]
      # amplitude-weighted substitution cost (mean weight)
      wbar <- 0.5 * (wi + wj)
      subc <- wbar * syllable_distance_matrix[s1[i - 1], s2[j - 1]]
      
      del  <- d[i - 1, j] + gap_scale * (gap_open + gap_extend * wi) # delete
      ins  <- d[i, j - 1] + gap_scale * (gap_open + gap_extend * wj) # insert
      sub  <- d[i - 1, j - 1] + subc                                # substitute
      
      d[i, j] <- min(del, ins, sub)
    }
  }
  
  score_raw <- d[m + 1, n + 1]
  
  
  
  m <- sum(syllables_mean$name == a)
  n <- sum(syllables_mean$name == b)
  
  # average per-syllable cost (symmetric)
  score_norm <- score_raw / ((m + n) / 2)
  
  return(score_norm)
}

# Gotoh affine-gap weighted edit distance for syllables
# - a, b: song names (must exist in syllables_mean$name)
# - syllables_mean: data frame with one row per syllable token
# - dist_matrix: pairwise syllable substitution costs aligned to row order of syllables_mean
# - amp_col: column in syllables_mean giving amplitude weight (e.g., "r_rms_amp")
# - gap_open: base cost to start a gap
# - gap_extend: per-element extend cost (will be amplitude-weighted)
# - gap_scale: global multiplier on gap costs
gotoh_dwed <- function(a, b) {
  
  # indices of syllables for each song
  s1 <- which(syllables_mean$name == a)
  s2 <- which(syllables_mean$name == b)
  m  <- length(s1); n <- length(s2)
  if (m == 0 || n == 0) stop("One of the songs has zero syllables.")
  
  # amplitude weights (normalize by median to keep magnitudes stable)
  amp <- syllables_mean[[amp_col]]

  w1 <- amp[s1]  # weights for deletions (gaps in b)
  w2 <- amp[s2]  # weights for insertions (gaps in a)
  
  avg_len <- mean(table(syllables_mean$name))  # dataset-wide average
  w1 <- w1 * (length(w1) / avg_len)
  w2 <- w2 * (length(w2) / avg_len)
  
  # DP matrices (use +Inf for impossible states)
  M  <- matrix(Inf, nrow = m + 1, ncol = n + 1) # end with match/sub
  Ia <- matrix(Inf, nrow = m + 1, ncol = n + 1) # gap in A (i.e., insertion in B): align A[i] to gap
  Ib <- matrix(Inf, nrow = m + 1, ncol = n + 1) # gap in B (i.e., deletion from A): align gap to B[j]
  
  # helpers to compute weighted open/extend
  # Deleting A[i] (gap in B): use w1[i]
  open_del  <- function(i) gap_scale * (gap_open + gap_extend * w1[i])
  extend_del<- function(i) gap_scale * (gap_extend * w1[i])
  # Inserting B[j] (gap in A): use w2[j]
  open_ins  <- function(j) gap_scale * (gap_open + gap_extend * w2[j])
  extend_ins<- function(j) gap_scale * (gap_extend * w2[j])
  
  # initialization
  M[1,1] <- syllable_distance_matrix[s1[1], s2[1]] * 0.5 * (w1[1] + w2[1]) # optional; or set via recurrences below
  M[1,1] <- 0  # cleaner to start from 0 then fill via loops
  
  M[1,1] <- 0
  Ia[1,1] <- Ib[1,1] <- Inf
  
  # first column: align A[1..i] to empty B via deletions (gaps in B) -> Ib
  for (i in 1:m) {
    if (i == 1) {
      Ib[i + 1, 1] <- min(Inf, M[i, 1] + open_del(i))         # open first deletion
    } else {
      Ib[i + 1, 1] <- min(Ib[i, 1] + extend_del(i),            # extend deletion run
                          M[i, 1]  + open_del(i))              # open new deletion run
    }
    # M and Ia remain Inf on this border
  }
  
  # first row: align empty A to B[1..j] via insertions (gaps in A) -> Ia
  for (j in 1:n) {
    if (j == 1) {
      Ia[1, j + 1] <- min(Inf, M[1, j] + open_ins(j))         # open first insertion
    } else {
      Ia[1, j + 1] <- min(Ia[1, j] + extend_ins(j),           # extend insertion run
                          M[1, j]  + open_ins(j))             # open new insertion run
    }
    # M and Ib remain Inf on this border
  }
  
  # fill the DP
  for (i in 1:m) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      # substitution cost weighted by loudness (mean of the two)
      wbar <- 0.5 * (w1[i] + w2[j])
      subc <- wbar * syllable_distance_matrix[s1[i], s2[j]]
      
      # states reaching M[i+1, j+1]
      M[i + 1, j + 1] <- min(
        M[i, j]  + subc,
        Ia[i, j] + subc,
        Ib[i, j] + subc
      )
      
      # gap in A (insert B[j]): align A[1..i] with B[1..j+1], last is insertion
      Ia[i + 1, j + 1] <- min(
        Ia[i + 1, j] + extend_ins(j),   # extend existing insertion with B[j]
        M[i + 1, j]  + open_ins(j)      # open new insertion with B[j]
      )
      
      # gap in B (delete A[i]): align A[1..i+1] with B[1..j], last is deletion
      Ib[i + 1, j + 1] <- min(
        Ib[i, j + 1] + extend_del(i),   # extend existing deletion with A[i]
        M[i, j + 1]  + open_del(i)      # open new deletion with A[i]
      )
    }
  }
  
  # best alignment ending anywhere at (m,n)
  score_raw <- min(M[m + 1, n + 1], Ia[m + 1, n + 1], Ib[m + 1, n + 1])
  
  m <- sum(syllables_mean$name == a)
  n <- sum(syllables_mean$name == b)
  
  # average per-syllable cost (symmetric)
  score_norm <- score_raw / ((m + n) / 2)
  
  return(score_norm)
}
```

# DTW
```{r}

audioT <- lapply(audio, t)   # each is time x freq




estimate_gamma <- function(audioT, n_samples = 20000, frac = 0.2, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(audioT)

  d <- numeric(n_samples)
  for (k in seq_len(n_samples)) {
    i <- sample.int(n, 1)
    j <- sample.int(n, 1)
    A <- audioT[[i]]
    B <- audioT[[j]]

    ti <- sample.int(nrow(A), 1)
    tj <- sample.int(nrow(B), 1)

    diff <- A[ti, ] - B[tj, ]
    d[k] <- sqrt(sum(diff * diff))
  }

  frac * median(d)
}

gamma <- estimate_gamma(audioT, n_samples = 20000, frac = 0.05)




asym_dtw_euclid <- function(A, B) {
  al <- dtw::dtw(
    A, B,
    step.pattern  = dtw::asymmetric,
    open.begin    = TRUE,
    open.end      = TRUE,
    distance.only = FALSE,
    keep.internals = FALSE,
    dist.method   = "Euclidean"
  )
  
    w_steps <- sum(diff(al$index1) == 0 | diff(al$index2) == 0)

  al$distance + gamma * w_steps
  
}

overlap_shift_pair <- function(A, B, s) {
  # A,B: time x freq, same ncol
  F <- ncol(A); stopifnot(ncol(B) == F)
  if (s == 0L) return(list(A, B))
  if (abs(s) >= F) return(list(A[, 0, drop=FALSE], B[, 0, drop=FALSE]))

  if (s > 0L) {
    # A shifted up by s vs B
    list(A[, (1+s):F, drop=FALSE],
         B[, 1:(F-s), drop=FALSE])
  } else {
    s <- -s
    list(A[, 1:(F-s), drop=FALSE],
         B[, (1+s):F, drop=FALSE])
  }
}

dtw_shift_invariant <- function(A, B, freq_max_shift = 8,
                                freq_step = 2) {
  shifts <- seq(-freq_max_shift, freq_max_shift, by = freq_step)
  best <- Inf

  for (s in shifts) {
    AB <- overlap_shift_pair(A, B, s)
    if (ncol(AB[[1]]) < 2L) next

    d1 <- asym_dtw_euclid(AB[[1]], AB[[2]])
    d2 <- asym_dtw_euclid(AB[[2]], AB[[1]])
    best <- min(best, mean(c(d1, d2)))
  }
  best
}
```

```{r}



mfcc_list <- list()


for (i in 1:length(songs_mean$name)){
  
  
  num <- sample(1:length(which(songs$name ==
                                 songs_mean$name[i])), 1)
  
  
  # Read WAV files
  sound <- readWave(
    paste(dir, songs_mean$name[i], sep = ""),
    units = "seconds",
    from = songs$begin[songs$name ==
                         songs_mean$name[i]][num],
    to = songs$end[songs$name ==
                     songs_mean$name[i]][num]
  )
  
  
  sound <- fir(
    wave = sound,
    from = 1000,
    # lower bound frequency in Hz
    to = 4500,
    # upper bound frequency in Hz
    bandpass = TRUE,
    output = "Wave"
  )
  
  
  
  # Compute MFCCs
  mfcc <- melfcc(sound, numcep = 13)
  
  
  # Average MFCCs over frames
  mean_mfcc <- colMeans(mfcc)
  
  mfcc_list[[i]] <- mean_mfcc
  
}

MFCC_dist <- function(a, b){
  
  mean_mfcc1 <- mfcc_list[[a]]
  mean_mfcc2 <- mfcc_list[[b]]
  
  return(dist(rbind(mean_mfcc1, mean_mfcc2), method = "euclidean"))
```

```{r}
mean_sim <- function(embeddings){
  
  
  rownames(embeddings) <- embeddings$filename
  
  
  
  embeddings %<>% dplyr::select(-filename)
  
  print(dim(embeddings))
  embeddings_cossim <- dist(embeddings) %>%
    as.matrix()

  song_files <- rownames(embeddings) %>% 
    strsplit(split = "_(?=[^_]*$)", perl = TRUE) %>%
    sapply(FUN = function(x){x[1]})
  
  
  song_files_u <- song_files %>%
    unique()
  
  song_files_u <- song_files_u[match(independent$name, song_files_u)]
  
  
  group_mean_sim <- function(a, b){
    song_a <- song_files_u[a]
    song_b <- song_files_u[b]
    
    a_v <- which(song_a == song_files)
    b_v <- which(song_b == song_files)
    
    sims <- c(embeddings_cossim[a_v, b_v]) 
    sims <- sims[sims != 0]
    
    return(mean(sims))
    
  }


  input_df <- as.data.frame(1:length(song_files_u))
  
  rownames(input_df) <- song_files_u
  
  mean_sim <- dist_make(input_df, group_mean_sim) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
    mean_sim <- 1 - mean_sim / max(mean_sim)
  
  return(mean_sim)

}
```

# Composite similarity
```{r}



Ulist <-
  list(
    1-as.matrix(dwed_matrix),
    1-as.matrix(DTWD),
    as.matrix(matrix_cor),
    1-as.matrix(MFCC),
    as.matrix(sim_birdnet),
    as.matrix(sim_perch)
  )


lapply(Ulist, dim)
# all should b

# Ulist: list of 6 n x n similarity matrices
n_metrics <- length(Ulist)
n <- nrow(Ulist[[1]])

# 3D array: [i, j, k] = similarity for pair (i,j) in metric k
Uarr <- simplify2array(Ulist)  # dimensions: n x n x 6

# z-score each metric using upper triangle (i < j)
Zarr <- array(NA_real_, dim = dim(Uarr))
upper_idx <- upper.tri(Uarr[,,1], diag = FALSE)

for (k in seq_len(n_metrics)) {
  M <- Uarr[,,k]
  vals <- M[upper_idx]
  mu  <- mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv <- sd(vals,   na.rm = TRUE)
  Zarr[,,k] <- (M - mu) / sdv
}

Ulist <-   list(
    Zarr[,,1],
    Zarr[,,2],
    Zarr[,,3],
    Zarr[,,4],
    Zarr[,,5],
    Zarr[,,6]
    )

# matrix: each column = flattened upper-tri z-scores of one metric
metric_vecs <- sapply(seq_len(n_metrics), function(k) Zarr[,,k][upper_idx])

Rho <- cor(metric_vecs, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
Rho


avg_abs_cor <- sapply(seq_len(n_metrics), function(k) {
  mean(abs(Rho[k, -k]), na.rm = TRUE)
})

# Higher avg_abs_cor -> more redundant -> smaller weight
meta_w <- 1 - avg_abs_cor
meta_w[meta_w < 0] <- 0  # just in case
meta_w <- meta_w / sum(meta_w)  # normalise to sum to 1

meta_w


composite_z <- function(z, p = 2, meta_w) {
  if (all(is.na(z))) return(NA_real_)
  s <- z                       # already centred at 0
  w <- (abs(s)^p) * meta_w     # local extremeness * global uniqueness
  if (sum(w, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(0)
  sum(w * s, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE)
}


p <- 2  # tune if you like: higher p -> more extreme-favouring

C <- apply(Zarr, c(1, 2), composite_z, p = p, meta_w = meta_w)

C[35, 34]









# C is n x n, can be positive or negative

scale_offdiag_to01 <- function(C, diag_value = NA_real_) {
  n <- nrow(C)
  off_idx <- row(C) != col(C)

  min_off <- min(C[off_idx], na.rm = TRUE)
  max_off <- max(C[off_idx], na.rm = TRUE)

  C01 <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)

  if (max_off > min_off) {
    C01[off_idx] <- (C[off_idx] - min_off) / (max_off - min_off)
  } else {
    C01[off_idx] <- 0.5  # all equal; choose whatever constant you like
  }

  diag(C01) <- diag_value
  C01
}

# usage:
C01 <- scale_offdiag_to01(C, diag_value = NA)  # or diag_value = 1


# or if you want symmetric around 0, keep C; if you want diag fixed:
diag(C01) <- 0  # or NA, depending on your use
```

```{r}
safe_scale <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(ux) <= 1L) {
    # no variation -> this dimension contributes nothing to distances
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  } else {
    return(as.numeric(scale(x)))
  }
}



create_pair_df <- function(max_days, max_km){
  
  ## 1. Make sure date and season are in the right form
  meta <- independent %>%
  mutate(
    lon = longitude,
    lat = latitude,
    date   = as.Date(date),
    season = factor(season),
    # days within each season (0 = first recording that season)
    day_in_season = ave(
      as.numeric(date),
      season,
      FUN = function(d) d - min(d)
    )
  )
  
  
  
  meta$cluster_id <- NA_character_
  


  
  for (s in levels(meta$season)) {
    idx <- which(meta$season == s)
    n   <- length(idx)
    
    if (n == 1) {
      # only one sample -> its own cluster
      meta$cluster_id[idx] <- paste0(s, "_1")
      next
    }
    
    # --- 1. geographic distances (km) ---
    coords <- as.matrix(meta[idx, c("lon", "lat")])  # lon, lat in degrees
    D_geo  <- geosphere::distm(coords, fun = geosphere::distHaversine) / 1000  # km
    
    # --- 2. temporal distances (days) ---
    day_num <- as.numeric(meta$date[idx])
    D_time  <- abs(outer(day_num, day_num, "-"))  # full n x n matrix
    
    # --- 3. combined distance encoding both limits ---
    # D_comb <= 1  <=>  D_geo <= 100 km  AND  D_time <= 30 days
    D_comb <- pmax(D_geo / max_km, D_time / max_days)
    diag(D_comb) <- 0  # distances to self are 0
    
    d_comb <- as.dist(D_comb)
    
    # --- 4. complete-link clustering & cut at height 1 ---
    hc <- hclust(d_comb, method = "complete")
    
    # all merges above height 1 are not allowed -> cut at h = 1
    cl <- cutree(hc, h = 1)
    
    # make cluster IDs unique across seasons
    meta$cluster_id[idx] <- paste0(s, "_", cl)
  }
  
  meta$cluster_id <- factor(meta$cluster_id)
  table(meta$cluster_id)
  
  independent <- meta
  
  length(unique(meta$cluster_id))
  
  
  
  coords <- as.matrix(meta[, c("lon", "lat")])  # lon, lat in degrees
  
  # distance matrix in meters, convert to km
  D_geo <- geosphere::distm(coords, fun = geosphere::distHaversine) / 1000
  
  # pairwise absolute difference in days
  D_time <- as.matrix(dist(as.numeric(meta$date)))  # dist already gives abs diffs
  
  n <- nrow(meta)
  idx_pairs <- t(combn(n, 2))  # all combinations of row indices (i < j)
  colnames(idx_pairs) <- c("i", "j")
  
  i <- idx_pairs[, "i"]
  j <- idx_pairs[, "j"]
  
  pair_df <- tibble(
    i = i,
    j = j,
    
    id_i = meta$name[i],
    id_j = meta$name[j],
    
    irruption_i = meta$cluster_id[i],
    irruption_j = meta$cluster_id[j],
    same_irruption = meta$cluster_id[i] == meta$cluster_id[j],
    
    season_i = meta$season[i],
    season_j = meta$season[j],
    same_season = meta$season[i] == meta$season[j],
    same_season_different_irruption = same_season & !same_irruption,
      
    # lookup distances from the matrices
    geo_km   = D_geo[cbind(i, j)],
    time_day = D_time[cbind(i, j)],
    
    # similarities
    DWE = Ulist[[1]][cbind(i, j)],
    DTW = Ulist[[2]][cbind(i, j)],
    COR = Ulist[[3]][cbind(i, j)],
    MFCC = Ulist[[4]][cbind(i, j)],
    BirdNET = Ulist[[5]][cbind(i, j)],
    Perch = Ulist[[6]][cbind(i, j)],
    combo_sim = Ucombo[cbind(i, j)]
  )
  
  
  
  independent %<>% mutate(irruption = as.factor(cluster_id))
  
  
  table(as.character(independent$season))
  
  
  # number of irruptions
  print(length(unique(independent$irruption)))
  
  # mean irruption size
  mean(table(independent$irruption))
  
  # sd of irruption size
  sd(table(independent$irruption))
  
  # range of irruption
  range(table(independent$irruption))
  
  return(list(pair_df, independent))

}
```

```{r}
perm_once <- function(independent, pair_df) {
  # 1. Permute irruption labels across individuals
  irrupt_perm <- independent %>%
    mutate(irruption_perm = sample(irruption)) %>%
    select(name, irruption_perm)

  # 2. Attach permuted irruptions to each member of each pair
  stat_tbl <- pair_df %>%
    select(id_i, id_j, combo_sim) %>%   # only what we need
    left_join(irrupt_perm %>% rename(id_i = name,
                                     irr_i = irruption_perm),
              by = "id_i") %>%
    left_join(irrupt_perm %>% rename(id_j = name,
                                     irr_j = irruption_perm),
              by = "id_j") %>%
    mutate(type = if_else(irr_i == irr_j, "within", "between")) %>%
    group_by(type) %>%
    summarise(mean_sim = mean(combo_sim), .groups = "drop")

  # 3. Return within - between
  stat_tbl$mean_sim[stat_tbl$type == "within"] -
    stat_tbl$mean_sim[stat_tbl$type == "between"]
}


set.seed(36)
B <- 10000  # number of permutations

perm_diffs <- map_dbl(1:B, ~ perm_once(independent, pair_df))

# two-sided
b_two <- sum(abs(perm_diffs) >= abs(obs_diff))
```

# Weighted bootstrap
```{r}



bca_ci_mean_individual_weighted <- function(df, R = 10000, conf = 0.95) {
  # df: subset of pair_df for one group (e.g. same_irruption == TRUE)
  # must contain: i, j, combo_sim
  
  # point estimate on full data (used as fallback)
  mean_full <- mean(df$combo_sim, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # all individuals in this subset
  inds <- sort(unique(c(df$i, df$j)))
  
  stat_fun <- function(ind_vec, idx) {
    # ind_vec: vector of all individual IDs for this group
    # idx: bootstrap indices (with replacement) into ind_vec
    
    samp_ids <- ind_vec[idx]        # bootstrap sample of individuals (with replacement)
    
    # multiplicity of each selected individual
    counts_tbl <- table(samp_ids)   # names(counts_tbl) = IDs; values = counts
    
    # keep only pairs for which BOTH individuals were selected at least once
    sub <- df[df$i %in% names(counts_tbl) & df$j %in% names(counts_tbl), ,
              drop = FALSE]
    
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) {
      # pathological tiny case: no valid pairs in this replicate
      return(mean_full)
    }
    
    # weights = multiplicity(i) * multiplicity(j)
    w_i <- as.numeric(counts_tbl[as.character(sub$i)])
    w_j <- as.numeric(counts_tbl[as.character(sub$j)])
    w   <- w_i * w_j
    
    # just in case, drop any rows with zero or NA weights
    keep <- !is.na(w) & w > 0
    if (!any(keep)) {
      return(mean_full)
    }
    
    weighted.mean(sub$combo_sim[keep], w[keep], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  # run the bootstrap over individuals
  b  <- boot(data = inds, statistic = stat_fun, R = R)
  ci <- boot.ci(b, type = "bca", conf = conf)
  
  tibble(
    mean_hat = as.numeric(b$t0),   # full-sample statistic
    ci_lower = ci$bca[1, 4],
    ci_upper = ci$bca[1, 5]
  )
}



set.seed(36)

ci_df_weighted <- pair_df %>%
  group_by(same_irruption) %>% 
  group_modify(~ bca_ci_mean_individual_weighted(.x, R = 10000)) %>%
  ungroup()

ci_df_weighted
```

# AUC

```{r}

# ROC
bca_auc_individual_weighted <- function(pair_df, R, conf = 0.95) {
  roc_full <- roc(response  = pair_df$same_irruption,
                  predictor = pair_df$combo_sim,
                  levels    = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                  direction = "<", # higher similarity predicts within-irruption
                  quiet     = TRUE)
  
  # plot(roc_full)
  auc_full <- as.numeric(auc(roc_full))
  
  inds <- sort(unique(c(pair_df$i, pair_df$j)))
  
  auc_weighted_stat <- function(ind_vec, idx) {
    samp_ids <- ind_vec[idx]
    # Preserve repeated individual draws through pair multiplicity weights.
    counts <- table(samp_ids)
    pair_weights <- as.numeric(counts[as.character(pair_df$i)]) *
                    as.numeric(counts[as.character(pair_df$j)])
    keep <- !is.na(pair_weights) & pair_weights > 0
    sub <- pair_df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    w <- pair_weights[keep]
    
    if (nrow(sub) == 0 || length(unique(sub$same_irruption)) < 2) {
      return(auc_full)
    }
    
    positive <- sub$same_irruption
    # PRROC supports frequency weights; class0 is the positive class.
    roc_sub <- PRROC::roc.curve(
      scores.class0 = sub$combo_sim[positive],
      scores.class1 = sub$combo_sim[!positive],
      weights.class0 = w[positive],
      weights.class1 = w[!positive],
      curve = FALSE
    )
    as.numeric(roc_sub$auc)
  }
  
  b_auc <- boot(data = inds, statistic = auc_weighted_stat, R = R)
  ci    <- boot.ci(b_auc, type = "bca", conf = conf)
  
  tibble::tibble(
    auc_full = auc_full,
    ci_lower = ci$bca[1, 4],
    ci_upper = ci$bca[1, 5]
  )
}

set.seed(36)
roc_auc_df <- bca_auc_individual_weighted(pair_df, R = 10000)


# PR
bca_pr_auc_and_baseline <- function(pair_df, R, conf = 0.95) {
  # full-data PR AUC and baseline
  scores_pos <- pair_df$combo_sim[pair_df$same_irruption]
  scores_neg <- pair_df$combo_sim[!pair_df$same_irruption]
  
  pr_full <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = scores_pos,
                      scores.class1 = scores_neg,
                      curve = T)
  pr_auc_full <- pr_full$auc.integral
  baseline_full <- mean(pair_df$same_irruption)
  
  # plot(pr_full)
  
  inds <- sort(unique(c(pair_df$i, pair_df$j)))
  
  pr_auc_weighted_stat <- function(ind_vec, idx) {
    samp_ids <- ind_vec[idx]
    # Preserve repeated individual draws through pair multiplicity weights.
    counts <- table(samp_ids)
    pair_weights <- as.numeric(counts[as.character(pair_df$i)]) *
                    as.numeric(counts[as.character(pair_df$j)])
    keep <- !is.na(pair_weights) & pair_weights > 0
    sub <- pair_df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    w <- pair_weights[keep]
    
    if (nrow(sub) == 0 || length(unique(sub$same_irruption)) < 2) {
      return(pr_auc_full)
    }
    
    scores_pos <- sub$combo_sim[sub$same_irruption]
    scores_neg <- sub$combo_sim[!sub$same_irruption]
    
    pr_sub <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = scores_pos,
                       scores.class1 = scores_neg,
                       weights.class0 = w[sub$same_irruption],
                       weights.class1 = w[!sub$same_irruption],
                       curve = FALSE)
    pr_sub$auc.integral
  }
  
  baseline_weighted_stat <- function(ind_vec, idx) {
    samp_ids <- ind_vec[idx]
    # Preserve repeated individual draws through pair multiplicity weights.
    counts <- table(samp_ids)
    pair_weights <- as.numeric(counts[as.character(pair_df$i)]) *
                    as.numeric(counts[as.character(pair_df$j)])
    keep <- !is.na(pair_weights) & pair_weights > 0
    sub <- pair_df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    w <- pair_weights[keep]
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(baseline_full)
    weighted.mean(sub$same_irruption, w)
  }
  
  b_pr   <- boot(data = inds, statistic = pr_auc_weighted_stat,   R = R)
  b_base <- boot(data = inds, statistic = baseline_weighted_stat, R = R)
  
  ci_pr   <- boot.ci(b_pr,   type = "bca", conf = conf)
  ci_base <- boot.ci(b_base, type = "bca", conf = conf)
  
  tibble::tibble(
    pr_auc_full   = pr_auc_full,
    pr_auc_lower  = ci_pr$bca[1, 4],
    pr_auc_upper  = ci_pr$bca[1, 5],
    baseline_full = baseline_full,
    baseline_lower = ci_base$bca[1, 4],
    baseline_upper = ci_base$bca[1, 5]
  )
}

set.seed(36)
pr_auc_df <- bca_pr_auc_and_baseline(pair_df, R = 10000)
```

# Robustness across individual acoustic metrics

This check compares within- and between-irruption similarity separately for the
six component metrics and the composite. Components are on the z-score scale
created above; the composite is on its existing 0--1 scale. All are oriented so
higher values mean greater similarity. ROC and PR AUC are directly comparable
across metrics, while mean differences retain their respective scales.

Individuals, not pairs, are resampled. Each pair receives the product of its two
individuals' bootstrap multiplicities; the same resample is used for every metric
and both pair classes. ROC AUC counts ties as half a success and treats within
irruption as positive (its direction is never selected from the data). The
composite is recomputed here with the same multiplicity weighting used in the
original AUC analyses above. Similarity matrices and
composite weights are held fixed. These checks assess sensitivity to acoustic
representation; they do not by themselves exclude shared recording artifacts.
PR AUC uses PRROC's integral with pair multiplicities as frequency weights, as in
the original composite analysis. Its no-skill baseline is the weighted proportion
of within-irruption pairs in each resample. This baseline is shared by all metrics
and is repeated in the summary table for convenience. The PR plot shows the
observed baseline, rather than the ROC reference of 0.5.

```{r acoustic_metric_robustness}
metric_robustness <- function(pair_data, R = 10000, conf = 0.95) {
  metrics <- c("DWE", "DTW", "COR", "MFCC", "BirdNET", "Perch", "combo_sim")
  required <- c("i", "j", "same_irruption", metrics)
  stopifnot(all(required %in% names(pair_data)), R >= 2,
            conf > 0, conf < 1)
  if (anyNA(pair_data[required]) ||
      !all(vapply(pair_data[metrics], function(x) all(is.finite(x)), logical(1)))) {
    stop("Metric robustness requires complete, finite scores on the same pairs.")
  }
  positive <- pair_data$same_irruption
  stopifnot(is.logical(positive), any(positive), any(!positive),
            all(pair_data$i != pair_data$j))
  pair_keys <- paste(pmin(pair_data$i, pair_data$j),
                     pmax(pair_data$i, pair_data$j), sep = ":")
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pair_keys))
  ids <- sort(unique(c(pair_data$i, pair_data$j)))
  ii <- match(pair_data$i, ids)
  jj <- match(pair_data$j, ids)
  scores <- as.matrix(pair_data[metrics])

  # Precompute score ranks, pooling ties, for an exact weighted ROC AUC.
  rank_groups <- lapply(metrics, function(metric) {
    x <- pair_data[[metric]]
    match(x, sort(unique(x)))
  })
  weighted_auc <- function(weights, groups) {
    totals <- rowsum(cbind(pos = weights * positive,
                          neg = weights * !positive), groups, reorder = TRUE)
    pos <- totals[, "pos"]
    neg <- totals[, "neg"]
    sum(pos * (cumsum(neg) - neg / 2)) / (sum(pos) * sum(neg))
  }
  statistic <- function(data, indices) {
    counts <- tabulate(indices, nbins = length(data))
    weights <- counts[ii] * counts[jj]
    within_weight <- sum(weights[positive])
    between_weight <- sum(weights[!positive])
    if (within_weight == 0 || between_weight == 0) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, length(metrics) * 6L))
    }
    within <- colSums(scores[positive, , drop = FALSE] * weights[positive]) /
      within_weight
    between <- colSums(scores[!positive, , drop = FALSE] * weights[!positive]) /
      between_weight
    auc <- vapply(rank_groups, function(g) weighted_auc(weights, g), numeric(1))
    pos <- positive & weights > 0
    neg <- !positive & weights > 0
    pr_auc <- vapply(seq_along(metrics), function(k) {
      PRROC::pr.curve(
        scores.class0 = scores[pos, k],
        scores.class1 = scores[neg, k],
        weights.class0 = weights[pos],
        weights.class1 = weights[neg],
        curve = FALSE
      )$auc.integral
    }, numeric(1))
    baseline <- rep(within_weight / (within_weight + between_weight), length(metrics))
    as.vector(rbind(within, between, within - between, auc, pr_auc, baseline))
  }
  b <- boot::boot(data = ids, statistic = statistic, R = R)
  # Explicit leave-one-individual-out influences for BCa acceleration.
  jack <- vapply(seq_along(ids), function(k) {
    statistic(ids, seq_along(ids)[-k])
  }, numeric(length(b$t0)))
  influences <- (length(ids) - 1) * (rowMeans(jack) - jack)
  intervals <- t(vapply(seq_along(b$t0), function(k) {
    values <- b$t[, k]
    if (any(!is.finite(values)) || any(!is.finite(influences[k, ]))) {
      warning("BCa CI unavailable for statistic ", k,
              ": a resample or jackknife sample lacks a pair class.")
      return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
    }
    if (all(values == b$t0[k])) return(rep(b$t0[k], 2))
    ci <- tryCatch(
      boot::boot.ci(b, conf = conf, type = "bca", index = k,
                    L = influences[k, ]),
      error = function(e) {
        warning("BCa CI unavailable for statistic ", k, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(ci$bca)) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
    as.numeric(ci$bca[1, 4:5])
  }, numeric(2)))
  summary <- data.frame(
    metric = rep(metrics, each = 6),
    statistic = rep(c("within_mean", "between_mean", "within_minus_between",
                      "roc_auc", "pr_auc", "pr_baseline"), times = length(metrics)),
    estimate = as.numeric(b$t0),
    ci_lower = intervals[, 1], ci_upper = intervals[, 2],
    valid_bootstraps = colSums(is.finite(b$t)),
    requested_bootstraps = R, confidence = conf,
    ci_method = "BCa individual bootstrap"
  )
  summary$ci_method[!is.finite(summary$ci_lower) |
                      !is.finite(summary$ci_upper)] <- "unavailable"
  list(summary = summary, bootstrap = b)
}

set.seed(36)
```

# Audio-based clustering and congruence with irruptions

This exploratory robustness check reverses the direction of the main analysis:
recordings are clustered using composite acoustic dissimilarity (`1 - combo_sim`),
then compared with the independently defined space/time irruption groups. Average
linkage is used because the composite need not be a Euclidean distance. Every
recording is included, including singleton irruptions; pairwise similarities are
aligned by recording ID. The diagonal of the dissimilarity matrix is zero.

The primary cut maximizes mean silhouette width across all `k = 2, ..., n - 1`,
with ties resolved toward smaller `k`. This choice uses audio only: neither
irruption labels nor seasons enter clustering or selection of `k`. Silhouettes
measure acoustic separation, and a low maximum suggests weak cluster structure;
searching over `k` still returns a cut even when there are no distinct groups.
See the [R silhouette documentation](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/cluster/html/silhouette.html).

Congruence is measured by the adjusted Rand index (ARI): 1 means identical
partitions, 0 is chance expectation under random label assignment with fixed
group sizes, and negative values indicate less agreement than that expectation.
The index is invariant to cluster names and permits different numbers of groups
([ARI reference](https://mclust-org.github.io/mclust/reference/adjustedRandIndex.html)).
A secondary cut fixes `k` to the number of irruptions to compare partitions at the
same resolution; it is explicitly label-informed and is not the primary result.
ARI across all candidate cuts is reported descriptively, never used to choose `k`.

For both the audio-selected and matched-K cuts, 9,999 recording-label permutations give a one-sided
test of greater-than-random agreement, keeping the audio clustering fixed and
preserving irruption sizes (and therefore the matched K). Both cuts use the same
label shuffles. A second test permutes within seasons, asking whether
agreement exceeds that explained by season membership alone. This requires
exchangeability of recording labels within the relevant permutation pool; neither
test by itself excludes spatial structure, repeated individuals, or shared
recording artifacts. If each season contains only one irruption, the within-season
test is unavailable. These are supplementary checks using the same recordings,
not validation on an independent dataset. Singleton irruptions are retained and
the contingency plot exposes splits/merges that the overall ARI may conceal.

```{r acoustic_clustering}
source("code/acoustic_clustering.R")
acoustic_clustering_result <- acoustic_cluster_robustness(
  pair_data = pair_df, metadata = independent, nperm = 9999, seed = 36
)
acoustic_clustering_result$summary
acoustic_clustering_result$permutation_summary

dir.create("supplement", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
for (component in c("summary", "permutation_summary", "profile",
                    "assignments", "contingency", "permutation_null")) {
  write.csv(acoustic_clustering_result[[component]],
            paste0("supplement/acoustic_clustering_", component, ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
}
saveRDS(acoustic_clustering_result, "supplement/acoustic_clustering_result.rds")
```

# PERMANOVA
```{r}




# Rarefaction




Permanova_alanysis <- function(pair_df_r,
                               k_max = 12,
                               B = 200,
                               nperm = 1000,
                               alpha = 0.05,
                               method = comp) {
  
  
  
  
  
  meta <- bind_rows(
    pair_df_r %>% transmute(id = id_i, group = irruption_i),
    pair_df_r %>% transmute(id = id_j, group = irruption_j)
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(group)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # sanity check: each sample id must map to exactly one group
  bad <- meta %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(n_groups = n_distinct(group), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_groups > 1)
  
  if (nrow(bad) > 0) {
    stop("Some sample IDs map to multiple groups. Fix mapping first. Offending IDs: ",
         paste(bad$id, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # collapse to a clean id -> group table
  meta <- meta %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(group = first(group), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group))
  





  # aggregate to unique unordered pairs
  pairs <- pair_df_r %>%
    filter(!is.na(id_i), !is.na(id_j)) %>%
    mutate(i = pmin(id_i, id_j),
           j = pmax(id_i, id_j)) %>%
    group_by(i, j) %>%
    summarise(sim = mean(combo_sim, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # define matrix order
  ids <- sort(unique(meta$id))
  n <- length(ids)
  
  S <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n, dimnames = list(ids, ids))
  diag(S) <- 1
  
  ii <- match(pairs$i, ids)
  jj <- match(pairs$j, ids)
  
  S[cbind(ii, jj)] <- pairs$sim
  S[cbind(jj, ii)] <- pairs$sim
  
  
  
  Dmat <- 1 - S
  diag(Dmat) <- 0
  
  mean(Dmat)
  D <- as.dist(Dmat)

  
  set.seed(36)
  

  # pick ONE parallel strategy:
  # Strategy A: parallelize inside vegan permutation tests:
  ncores <- 8   # set to what SLURM gives you (e.g. Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK"))
  # Strategy B: parallelize across B replicates (future.apply / furrr) and set ncores <- 1
  
  
  cl <- makeCluster(ncores)
  clusterEvalQ(cl, library(vegan))   # load vegan on workers
  clusterSetRNGStream(cl, 1)         # optional: reproducible RNG streams
  


  Dmat <- as.matrix(D)
  dimnames(Dmat) <- list(ids, ids)

  # align meta rows to ids ONCE
  meta0 <- meta[match(ids, meta$id), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(all(meta0$id == ids))

  tab <- table(meta0$group)

  # pre-split indices by group once
  idx_by_group_all <- split(seq_len(nrow(meta0)), meta0$group)

  R2_list    <- vector("list", k_max-2)
  p_hat      <- integer(k_max-2)
  disp_hat   <- integer(k_max-2)
  n_vec      <- integer(k_max-2)
  R2_CI_min  <- integer(k_max-2)
  R2_CI_max  <- integer(k_max-2)
  R2_CI_mean  <- integer(k_max-2)

  for (k in 3:k_max) {

    good_groups <- names(tab)[tab >= k]
    idx_by_group <- idx_by_group_all[good_groups]

    # total n in each subsample
    n_sub <- k * length(idx_by_group)
    n_vec[k-2] <- sum(tab[good_groups])

    # precompute permutation index matrix once per k (reused across B replicates)
    # each row is a permutation of 1:n_sub
    perm_mat <- shuffleSet(n = n_sub, nset = nperm)

    out <- replicate(B, {
      keep_idx <- unlist(lapply(idx_by_group, function(v) v[sample.int(length(v), k)]),
                         use.names = FALSE)

      Dsub <- as.dist(Dmat[keep_idx, keep_idx])
      metasub <- meta0[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]

    perm <- adonis2(Dsub ~ group, data = metasub, permutations = nperm)

    bd <- betadisper(Dsub, metasub$group, add = "cailliez")
    disp_p <- permutest(bd, permutations = nperm)$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]

    return(c(R2 = perm$R2[1],
             p = perm$`Pr(>F)`[1],
             disp_p = disp_p))

    })
    


    
    out <- t(out)
    R2_list[[k-2]] <- out[, "R2"]
    p_hat[[k-2]]    <- (out[, "p"] < alpha) %>% mean()
    disp_hat[[k-2]] <- (out[, "disp_p"] < alpha) %>% mean()
    R2_CI_min[[k-2]]  <- quantile(out[, "R2"], c(0.025, 0.975))[1]
    R2_CI_max[[k-2]]  <- quantile(out[, "R2"], c(0.025, 0.975))[2]
    R2_CI_mean[[k-2]]  <- mean(out[, "R2"])
  }

  R2_df <- tibble(
    k = 3:k_max,
    b = R2_list,
    p = p_hat,
    disp_p = disp_hat,
    n = n_vec,
    R2_CI_min = R2_CI_min,
    R2_CI_max = R2_CI_max,
    R2_CI_mean = R2_CI_mean
  )

  # your density block (minor tweak: scale() -> numeric)
  all_y <- unlist(R2_df$b)
  y_grid <- seq(min(all_y, na.rm = TRUE), max(all_y, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 200)

  dens_df <- R2_df %>%
    mutate(dens = map(b, ~{
      v <- .x
      v <- v[is.finite(v)]
      if (length(v) < 2) {
        tibble(y = y_grid, density = 0)
      } else {
        breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)
        d <- hist(v, breaks = breaks,  plot = FALSE) 
        tibble(y = d$mids, density = d$counts/B)
      }
    })) %>%
    select(k, dens, p, disp_p, n) %>%
    unnest(dens)

  # 3) Plot heat map columns
  permanova_gelplot <-
ggplot(dens_df, aes(x = k, y = y, fill = density)) +
  geom_raster() +

  # lines
  geom_line(aes(y = p,     color = "Main test p"),
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = disp_p, color = "Dispersion p"), linewidth = 0.8) +

  # points
  geom_point(aes(y = p,     color = "Main test p"), size = 4, shape = 18) +
  geom_point(aes(y = disp_p, color = "Dispersion p"), size = 3, shape = 16) +

  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n), y = 1.05), color = "black", size = 3) +
  labs(y = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = 1:k_max,
    labels = 1:k_max,
    minor_breaks = seq(0.5, k_max, by = 1)
  ) +

  # heatmap legend (fill)
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    limits = c(0, 0.6),
    low = "transparent", mid = "transparent", high = "limegreen",
    name = expression(~~R^2)
  ) +

  # line/point legend (color)
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    breaks = c("Main test p", "Dispersion p"), 
    values = c("Main test p" = "purple",
               "Dispersion p" = "darkcyan")
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.1)),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.1)),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.1))
  )

    stopCluster(cl)
    

  return(list(R2_df, permanova_gelplot))
  
  }


  
  

out <- Permanova_alanysis(pair_df)

  
ggsave(paste0("supplement/permanova_plot_", method, ".png"),
     out[2],
     units = "px",
     width = 2400,
     height = 1500)
```

```{r}
geo_mean <- mean(pair_df$geo_km, na.rm = TRUE)

  mutate(
    i = trimws(as.character(i)),
    j = trimws(as.character(j)),
    geo_km = as.numeric(geo_km),

  )

  pair_df %>%
    transmute(
      id = i,

) %>%
```

# 2 Helper functions
```{r}
pair_key <- function(a, b) {
  a <- trimws(as.character(a))
  b <- trimws(as.character(b))
  
  lo <- ifelse(a <= b, a, b)
  hi <- ifelse(a <= b, b, a)
  
  paste(lo, hi, sep = "___")
}



make_node_perm <- function(inds, id_block = NULL) {
  
  inds <- trimws(as.character(inds))
  
  if (is.null(id_block)) {
    out <- sample(inds, length(inds), replace = FALSE)
    names(out) <- inds
    return(out)
  }
  
  id_block <- id_block %>%
    mutate(
      id = trimws(as.character(id)),
      block = trimws(as.character(block))
    ) %>%
    distinct(id, block)
  
  bad_ids <- id_block %>%
    count(id) %>%
    filter(n > 1)
  
  if (nrow(bad_ids) > 0) {
    print(bad_ids)
    stop("Some individuals occur in more than one block.")
  }
  
  missing_ids <- setdiff(inds, id_block$id)
  
  if (length(missing_ids) > 0) {
    print(missing_ids)
    stop("Some individuals are missing from id_block.")
  }
  
  block_vec <- id_block$block[match(inds, id_block$id)]
  names(block_vec) <- inds
  
  out <- inds
  names(out) <- inds
  
  for (bl in unique(block_vec)) {
    ids_bl <- inds[block_vec == bl]
    out[ids_bl] <- sample(ids_bl, length(ids_bl), replace = FALSE)
  }
  
  out
}


```

# 3 Model statistic helpers
```{r}
drop_r2_formula_weighted <- function(dat,
                                     full_formula,
                                     reduced_formula,
                                     weights_col = ".w") {
  
  needed <- unique(c(
    all.vars(full_formula),
    all.vars(reduced_formula),
    weights_col
  ))
  
  dat <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, needed, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
  dat <- dat[dat[[weights_col]] > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (nrow(dat) < 5) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  full_fit <- try(
    lm(full_formula, data = dat, weights = dat[[weights_col]]),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  red_fit <- try(
    lm(reduced_formula, data = dat, weights = dat[[weights_col]]),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(full_fit, "try-error") || inherits(red_fit, "try-error")) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  r2_full <- summary(full_fit)$r.squared
  r2_red  <- summary(red_fit)$r.squared
  
  r2_full - r2_red
}

coef_from_model_weighted <- function(dat,
                                     formula,
                                     terms,
                                     weights_col = ".w") {
  
  needed <- unique(c(all.vars(formula), weights_col))
  
  dat <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, needed, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
  dat <- dat[dat[[weights_col]] > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  
  out <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(terms)), terms)
  
  fit <- try(
    lm(formula, data = dat, weights = dat[[weights_col]]),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    return(out)
  }
  
  cf <- coef(fit)
  keep <- names(out) %in% names(cf)
  out[keep] <- cf[names(out)[keep]]
  
  out
}


```


# 4 Statistics for additive and interaction models
```{r}
stat_additive_raw_weighted <- function(dat, weights_col = ".w") {
  
  drop_geo <- drop_r2_formula_weighted(
    dat = dat,
    full_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km + time_day,
    reduced_formula = combo_sim ~ time_day,
    weights_col = weights_col
  )
  
  drop_time <- drop_r2_formula_weighted(
    dat = dat,
    full_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km + time_day,
    reduced_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km,
    weights_col = weights_col
  )
  
  coefs <- coef_from_model_weighted(
    dat = dat,
    formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km + time_day,
    terms = c("(Intercept)", "geo_km", "time_day"),
    weights_col = weights_col
  )
  
  c(
    drop_r2__geo_km = unname(drop_geo),
    drop_r2__time_day = unname(drop_time),
    coef__intercept = unname(coefs["(Intercept)"]),
    coef__geo_km = unname(coefs["geo_km"]),
    coef__time_day = unname(coefs["time_day"])
  )
}
```

# 5 Cluster/node bootstrap for drop-one R2 and coefficients
```{r}
cluster_boot_stats_bca_pair_weights <- function(df,
                                                stat_fun,
                                                subset_name,
                                                model_name,
                                                id_cols = c("i", "j"),
                                                R = 2000,
                                                conf = 0.95) {
  
  df[[id_cols[1]]] <- trimws(as.character(df[[id_cols[1]]]))
  df[[id_cols[2]]] <- trimws(as.character(df[[id_cols[2]]]))
  
  inds <- sort(unique(c(df[[id_cols[1]]], df[[id_cols[2]]])))
  
  # Full-data point estimate: every pair has weight 1
  df_point <- df
  df_point$.w <- 1
  
  point <- stat_fun(df_point, weights_col = ".w")
  stat_names <- names(point)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(point))) {
    stop("Some observed statistics are non-finite.")
  }
  
  boot_fun <- function(ind_vec, idx) {
    
    samp_inds <- ind_vec[idx]
    
    counts <- table(factor(samp_inds, levels = ind_vec))
    
    count_i <- as.numeric(counts[df[[id_cols[1]]]])
    count_j <- as.numeric(counts[df[[id_cols[2]]]])
    
    df_boot <- df
    df_boot$.w <- count_i * count_j
    
    df_boot <- df_boot[df_boot$.w > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    
    val <- try(
      stat_fun(df_boot, weights_col = ".w"),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (inherits(val, "try-error") ||
        length(val) != length(point) ||
        any(!is.finite(val))) {
      val <- point
    }
    
    as.numeric(val)
  }
  
  b <- boot::boot(
    data = inds,
    statistic = boot_fun,
    R = R
  )
  
  colnames(b$t) <- stat_names
  names(b$t0) <- stat_names
  
  summary_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(stat_names), function(k) {
    
    vals <- b$t[, k]
    
    ci <- try(
      boot::boot.ci(b, type = "bca", conf = conf, index = k),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    ci_lower <- NA_real_
    ci_upper <- NA_real_
    ci_type <- "BCa"
    
    if (!inherits(ci, "try-error") && !is.null(ci$bca)) {
      ci_lower <- ci$bca[1, 4]
      ci_upper <- ci$bca[1, 5]
    } else {
      ci_lower <- unname(quantile(vals, probs = (1 - conf) / 2, na.rm = TRUE))
      ci_upper <- unname(quantile(vals, probs = 1 - (1 - conf) / 2, na.rm = TRUE))
      ci_type <- "percentile_fallback"
    }
    
    stat_name <- stat_names[k]
    
    tibble::tibble(
      subset = subset_name,
      model = model_name,
      stat = stat_name,
      stat_type = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("^drop_r2__", stat_name) ~ "drop_r2",
        grepl("^coef__", stat_name) ~ "coefficient",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ),
      term = stat_name %>%
        sub("^drop_r2__", "", .) %>%
        sub("^coef__", "", .),
      estimate = as.numeric(b$t0[k]),
      ci_lower = ci_lower,
      ci_upper = ci_upper,
      se_boot = sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      ci_type = ci_type
    )
  })
  
  draws_tbl <- as_tibble(b$t) %>%
    mutate(draw = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -draw,
      names_to = "stat",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      subset = subset_name,
      model = model_name,
      stat_type = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("^drop_r2__", stat) ~ "drop_r2",
        grepl("^coef__", stat) ~ "coefficient",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ),
      term = stat %>%
        sub("^drop_r2__", "", .) %>%
        sub("^coef__", "", .)
    ) %>%
    select(subset, model, draw, stat_type, term, stat, value)
  
  list(
    summary = summary_tbl,
    draws = draws_tbl,
    boot_object = b
  )
}



set.seed(36)
```

# 6 Freedman–Lane node-label permutation test
```{r}
node_perm_freedman_lane_drop_r2 <- function(df,
                                            term,
                                            full_formula,
                                            reduced_formula,
                                            y_col = "combo_sim",
                                            id_cols = c("i", "j"),
                                            B = 9999,
                                            id_block = NULL) {
  
  needed <- unique(c(
    id_cols,
    all.vars(full_formula),
    all.vars(reduced_formula)
  ))
  
  df <- df[complete.cases(df[, needed, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
  
  df[[id_cols[1]]] <- trimws(as.character(df[[id_cols[1]]]))
  df[[id_cols[2]]] <- trimws(as.character(df[[id_cols[2]]]))
  
  obs <- drop_r2_formula(
    dat = df,
    full_formula = full_formula,
    reduced_formula = reduced_formula
  )
  
  if (!is.finite(obs)) {
    stop("Observed drop-R2 could not be calculated.")
  }
  
  reduced_fit <- lm(reduced_formula, data = df)
  
  fitted_reduced <- fitted(reduced_fit)
  resid_reduced <- residuals(reduced_fit)
  
  inds <- sort(unique(c(df[[id_cols[1]]], df[[id_cols[2]]])))
  
  keys <- pair_key(df[[id_cols[1]]], df[[id_cols[2]]])
  
  if (anyDuplicated(keys)) {
    stop("Permutation function assumes one row per unordered pair.")
  }
  
  resid_lookup <- setNames(resid_reduced, keys)
  
  perm_stats <- rep(NA_real_, B)
  
  n_missing_lookup <- 0
  n_nonfinite_stat <- 0
  
  for (bb in seq_len(B)) {
    
    perm_map <- make_node_perm(inds, id_block = id_block)
    
    perm_i <- perm_map[df[[id_cols[1]]]]
    perm_j <- perm_map[df[[id_cols[2]]]]
    
    perm_keys <- pair_key(perm_i, perm_j)
    perm_resid <- unname(resid_lookup[perm_keys])
    
    if (anyNA(perm_resid)) {
      n_missing_lookup <- n_missing_lookup + 1
      next
    }
    
    df_perm <- df
    df_perm[[y_col]] <- fitted_reduced + perm_resid
    
    stat <- drop_r2_formula(
      dat = df_perm,
      full_formula = full_formula,
      reduced_formula = reduced_formula
    )
    
    if (!is.finite(stat)) {
      n_nonfinite_stat <- n_nonfinite_stat + 1
      next
    }
    
    perm_stats[bb] <- stat
  }
  
  vals <- perm_stats[is.finite(perm_stats)]
  
  p_perm <- (1 + sum(vals >= obs)) / (1 + length(vals))
  
  tibble(
    term = term,
    drop_r2_hat = obs,
    p_perm = p_perm,
    n_perm_valid = length(vals),
    n_missing_lookup = n_missing_lookup,
    n_nonfinite_stat = n_nonfinite_stat
  )
}




set.seed(36)

perm_results_additive_raw <- bind_rows(
  
  node_perm_freedman_lane_drop_r2(
    df = pair_within,
    term = "geo_km",
    full_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km + time_day,
    reduced_formula = combo_sim ~ time_day,
    B = 9999,
    id_block = id_block
  ) %>%
    mutate(subset = "within", model = "additive_raw"),
  
  node_perm_freedman_lane_drop_r2(
    df = pair_within,
    term = "time_day",
    full_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km + time_day,
    reduced_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km,
    B = 9999,
    id_block = id_block
  ) %>%
    mutate(subset = "within", model = "additive_raw"),
  
  node_perm_freedman_lane_drop_r2(
    df = pair_between,
    term = "geo_km",
    full_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km + time_day,
    reduced_formula = combo_sim ~ time_day,
    B = 9999,
    id_block = id_block
  ) %>%
    mutate(subset = "between", model = "additive_raw"),
  
  node_perm_freedman_lane_drop_r2(
    df = pair_between,
    term = "time_day",
    full_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km + time_day,
    reduced_formula = combo_sim ~ geo_km,
    B = 9999,
    id_block = id_block
  ) %>%
    mutate(subset = "between", model = "additive_raw")
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_holm_all = p.adjust(p_perm, method = "holm")
  ) %>%
  group_by(subset) %>%
  mutate(
    p_holm_within_subset = p.adjust(p_perm, method = "holm")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()



```

# Dimension reduction
```{r}


D <- 1-Ucombo



# --- 1) Fit NMDS across candidate dimensions ---
set.seed(36)
nmds_1 <- metaMDS(D, k = 1)$points

cor(dist(scale(nmds_1)), as.dist(Ucombo), method = "spearman")


df <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(site_scores),
  nmds_1 = nmds_1,
  site_scores,
  Irruptions = independent$irruption,
  labels = independent$symbol
)

Xk <- as.matrix(df[, paste0("NMDS", 1:k_best)])
Xk_sc <- scale(Xk)
pc <- principal_curve(Xk_sc)

center <- attr(Xk_sc, "scaled:center")
sc     <- attr(Xk_sc, "scaled:scale")

# Unscale projected points and ordered curve points
s_unscaled <- sweep(sweep(pc$s, 2, sc, `*`), 2, center, `+`)

curve12 <- as.data.frame(s_unscaled[pc$ord, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
colnames(curve12) <- c("NMDS1","NMDS2")



ggplot(data = df, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, colour = Irruptions, fill = Irruptions)) +
  geom_path(data = curve12, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  stat_stars(alpha = 0.3) +
  # geom_label(size = 0, label.r = unit(0.0, "lines"), label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = labels, color = Irruptions)) +
  geom_label(size = 3, label.r = unit(0.0, "lines"), label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"), label.size = NA, fontface="bold", show.legend = FALSE, aes(fill = Irruptions, x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = labels), color = "white") +
    geom_path(data = curve12, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nice_colors(length(unique(independent$irruption)))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = nice_colors(length(unique(independent$irruption)))) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        # legend.key.spacing.y = unit(-0.3, "cm"),
        legend.position = "NA")
```

# Timeline

```{r}


geo_func <- function(a, b){
  geosphere::distHaversine(a, b)
}


timeline_geo_dist <- apply(independent, 1, function(x){
  geo_func(as.numeric(unlist(x[c(3,2)])), c("Longitude" = 29.45, "Latitude" = -23.9))
})

timeline_df <- independent[timeline_geo_dist < 40000,]

timeline_df$date <- as.Date(timeline_df$date)

length(unique(timeline_df$irruption))

timeline_df$nmds_1 <- -scale(nmds_1)[as.numeric(rownames(timeline_df))]

median_samples <- timeline_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(nmds_1)) %>%
  group_by(irruption) %>%
  arrange(nmds_1, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    min_nmds_1 = first(nmds_1),
    max_nmds_1 = last(nmds_1),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  slice(ceiling(n() / 2)) %>%   # lower median when n is even
  ungroup()

length(median_samples$irruption)

rsvg::rsvg_svg("../software/glyph_icons/circle.svg", file = "../software/glyph_icons/circle.svg")

rsvg::rsvg_svg("../software/glyph_icons/star_0.svg", file = "../software/glyph_icons/star_0.svg")

make_glyph <- function(svg_file, label, text_col = "white",
                       fill  = "black",
                       stroke = NULL,
                       alpha = 1,
                       size = unit(18, "pt"),
                       text_size = 12,
                       label_nudge_x = 0,
                       label_nudge_y = 0,
                       fontface = "bold") {
  
  pic <- grImport2::readPicture(svg_file)
  
  icon <- grImport2::pictureGrob(
    pic,
    width = unit(size, "pt"), height = unit(size, "pt"), just = "center",
    gpFUN = function(gp0) {
      # override fill (use adjustcolor to add alpha)
      gp0$fill <- grDevices::adjustcolor(fill, alpha.f = alpha)
      if (!is.null(stroke)) gp0$col <- stroke
      gp0
    }
  )
  
  txt <- grid::textGrob(label, hjust = 0.5,
                        x = unit(0.5, "npc") + unit(label_nudge_x, "pt"),
                        y = unit(0.5, "npc") + unit(label_nudge_y, "pt"),
                        gp = grid::gpar(col = text_col, fontsize = text_size, fontface = fontface))
  
  grid::grobTree(icon, txt)
}

star <- "../software/glyph_icons/star_0.svg"

  star,

  size = 20,

  label_nudge_x = 0,
  label_nudge_y = c(-1, -1, -1, -1, -1.2, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5),
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)

                        by = "1 year")

mid_years <- year_starts[-length(year_starts)] +
  (year_starts[-1] - year_starts[-length(year_starts)]) / 2

mid_years2 <- mid_years[-c(1, length(mid_years))]

  geom_errorbar(data = median_samples %>% filter(n != 1), aes(group = irruption, x = date,

    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
```

```{r}


# unique_locations$callout_ang <- numeric(nrow(unique_locations))





compute_callout_angles_with_obstacles <- function(df,
                                                 obstacles = NULL,
                                                 lon_col = "longitude",
                                                 lat_col = "latitude",
                                                 obs_lon_col = "lon",
                                                 obs_lat_col = "lat",
                                                 r = 0.2,
                                                 angle_grid_n = 32,
                                                 # speed: only consider k nearest anchors per point
                                                 k = 12,
                                                 # (A) endpoint–endpoint dispersion among your labels
                                                 min_sep_end = 0.12,
                                                 w_end = 1,
                                                 # (B) endpoint near any anchor point (except itself)
                                                 min_sep_point = 0.10,
                                                 w_point = 3,
                                                 # (C) segment samples near anchor points
                                                 min_sep_seg_point = 0.06,
                                                 w_seg_point = 2,
                                                 seg_t = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
                                                 # (D) endpoint near obstacle points (other labels)
                                                 min_sep_obs = 0.12,
                                                 w_obs = 2,
                                                 # (E) segment samples near obstacle points
                                                 min_sep_seg_obs = 0.08,
                                                 w_seg_obs = 1.5,
                                                 max_iter = 20,
                                                 seed = 1) {

  set.seed(seed)

  x0 <- df[[lon_col]]
  y0 <- df[[lat_col]]
  n  <- length(x0)
  if (n < 2) return(rep(0, n))

  hypot <- function(dx, dy) sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)

  # Obstacles as points (may be empty)
  if (!is.null(obstacles) && nrow(obstacles) > 0) {
    xo <- obstacles[[obs_lon_col]]
    yo <- obstacles[[obs_lat_col]]
    m <- length(xo)
  } else {
    xo <- numeric(0); yo <- numeric(0); m <- 0
  }
  
  # Candidate angles
  angle_grid <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = angle_grid_n + 1)[-(angle_grid_n + 1)]

  # Neighbor sets among anchors (for speed)
  D0 <- as.matrix(dist(cbind(x0, y0)))
  diag(D0) <- Inf
  if (is.infinite(k)) {
    nbr <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) setdiff(seq_len(n), i))
  } else {
    k_use <- min(k, n - 1)
    nbr <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) order(D0[i, ])[seq_len(k_use)])
  }

  # Initialize: repulsion away from nearby anchors; snap to grid
  init_ang <- numeric(n)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    vx <- 0; vy <- 0
    for (j in nbr[[i]]) {
      dx <- x0[i] - x0[j]
      dy <- y0[i] - y0[j]
      dij <- hypot(dx, dy)
      w <- 1 / max(dij, 1e-6)
      vx <- vx + w * dx
      vy <- vy + w * dy
    }
    a <- if (abs(vx) + abs(vy) < 1e-12) runif(1, 0, 2*pi) else atan2(vy, vx)
    if (a < 0) a <- a + 2*pi
    init_ang[i] <- a
  }

  snap_to_grid <- function(a) {
    diffs <- abs(((a - angle_grid + pi) %% (2*pi)) - pi)
    angle_grid[which.min(diffs)]
  }
  ang <- vapply(init_ang, snap_to_grid, numeric(1))

  score_angles <- function(ang) {
    x1 <- x0 + r * cos(ang)
    y1 <- y0 + r * sin(ang)

    # (A) Endpoint–endpoint crowding among your labels
    end_pen <- 0
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      for (j in nbr[[i]]) {
        if (j <= i) next
        d <- hypot(x1[i] - x1[j], y1[i] - y1[j])
        over <- min_sep_end - d
        if (over > 0) end_pen <- end_pen + over^2
      }
    }

    # (B) Endpoint near other anchor points
    pt_pen <- 0
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      for (j in nbr[[i]]) {
        d <- hypot(x1[i] - x0[j], y1[i] - y0[j])
        over <- min_sep_point - d
        if (over > 0) pt_pen <- pt_pen + over^2
      }
    }

    # (C) Segment samples near anchor points
    segpt_pen <- 0
    for (t in seg_t) {
      xs <- x0 + t * (x1 - x0)
      ys <- y0 + t * (y1 - y0)
      for (i in seq_len(n)) {
        for (j in nbr[[i]]) {
          d <- hypot(xs[i] - x0[j], ys[i] - y0[j])
          over <- min_sep_seg_point - d
          if (over > 0) segpt_pen <- segpt_pen + over^2
        }
      }
    }

    # (D) Endpoint near external obstacle points
    obs_pen <- 0
    if (m > 0) {
      # compute all distances x1/y1 to xo/yo (n x m)
      dxo <- outer(x1, xo, "-")
      dyo <- outer(y1, yo, "-")
      dobs <- sqrt(dxo*dxo + dyo*dyo)
      over <- pmax(0, min_sep_obs - dobs)
      obs_pen <- sum(over^2)
    }

    # (E) Segment samples near external obstacle points
    segobs_pen <- 0
    if (m > 0) {
      for (t in seg_t) {
        xs <- x0 + t * (x1 - x0)
        ys <- y0 + t * (y1 - y0)
        dxo <- outer(xs, xo, "-")
        dyo <- outer(ys, yo, "-")
        dobs <- sqrt(dxo*dxo + dyo*dyo)
        over <- pmax(0, min_sep_seg_obs - dobs)
        segobs_pen <- segobs_pen + sum(over^2)
      }
    }

    w_end * end_pen +
      w_point * pt_pen +
      w_seg_point * segpt_pen +
      w_obs * obs_pen +
      w_seg_obs * segobs_pen
  }

  best <- score_angles(ang)

  # Coordinate descent over discrete angles
  for (it in seq_len(max_iter)) {
    changed <- 0
    for (i in sample.int(n)) {
      scores <- numeric(length(angle_grid))
      for (c in seq_along(angle_grid)) {
        ang_try <- ang
        ang_try[i] <- angle_grid[c]
        scores[c] <- score_angles(ang_try)
      }
      c_best <- which.min(scores)
      if (scores[c_best] < best - 1e-12) {
        ang[i] <- angle_grid[c_best]
        best <- scores[c_best]
        changed <- changed + 1
      }
    }
    if (changed == 0) break
  }

  ang
}
```

```{r}
  if (n %in% c(2, 5, 7, 8, 10)){

}
  
    
    x0 <- max(spectrogram$data$time) * 0.03

  g <- make_glyph(

}
```

```{r}
save_songs <- function(species, low, high){
  
  if (species == "Mirafra passerina"){return()}

  song_data <-
    imp_raven(
      "Data/selections_songs/",
      files = c(paste(species, "selections.txt")),
      all.data = T
    )
  
  
  
  song_data %<>% refactor_names()


  folder <- paste0(species, "_songs")

  
  dir.create(folder)

  for (a in 1:length(song_data$name)){
    
    print(a)
    print(song_data$name[a])
    file_a <- readWave(song_data$path[a],
                       units = "seconds",
                       from = song_data$begin[a],
                       to = song_data$end[a])


    sam_a <- fir(wave = file_a,
                 from = low, # lower bound frequency in Hz
                 to = high, # upper bound frequency in Hz
                 bandpass = TRUE,
                 output = "Wave")

    savewav(sam_a,
            filename = paste0(
              paste0(folder, "/"),
              song_data$name[a],
              "_",
              a,
              ".wav"
            ))

  }


}

                         mean_mesasured_strophs = c(mean(table(samples))))
    
    strophs_measured_table <- rbind(strophs_measured_table, new_df)
  
}
```
