# Repetoire size

```{r}

## ============================================================
## Estimate maximum individual repertoire size per species
## Two ways:
##   (1) Effort-standardized maximum observed repertoire at m songs (rarefaction)
##   (2) Maximum asymptotic repertoire via Chao1 (abundance-based)
##
## Assumptions about your objects (per species suffix in taxa_list):
##   - song_df_<species> : data.frame with at least column `name` (individual ID)
##   - embeddings_<species> : data.frame with embedding columns (numeric).
##       If it does not contain `name`, we will take it from song_df_<species>
##   - Each row corresponds to a song token / measurement (NOT one row per individual),
##     so individuals appear on multiple rows.
##
## If your species names contain spaces/special chars, ensure the object suffixes
## match exactly what you used when naming song_df_* and embeddings_*.
## ============================================================
comparison_meta <- read.csv("Data/comparison_meta - Sheet1.csv")



## -----------------------
## User-tunable parameters
## -----------------------
m_effort        <- 30   # standardized effort (songs per individual) for rarefaction
n_rarefy        <- 3000  # number of rarefaction resamples per individual
min_cluster_sz  <- 2    # HDBSCAN minPts (small values allow small repeated types)
q_assign        <- 0.95 # quantile cutoff for assigning noise to nearest cluster
use_pca         <- F
max_pcs         <- 50   # PCA dimensionality cap (species-level)
eps_norm        <- 1e-12

tau_one_type <- mean(Mirafra_pulpa_d95[!is.na(Mirafra_pulpa_d95)])
tau_one_type <- 0.08
noise_policy <- "ignore"


Mirafra_pulpa_d95 <- c()

## -----------------------
## Helper functions
## -----------------------

row_l2_normalize <- function(X, eps = 1e-12) {
  norms <- sqrt(rowSums(X^2))
  norms[norms < eps] <- 1
  X / norms
}

extract_embedding_matrix <- function(df, exclude = c("name")) {
  keep_num <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))
  keep_num[names(keep_num) %in% exclude] <- FALSE
  X <- as.matrix(df[, keep_num, drop = FALSE])
  if (ncol(X) == 0) stop("No numeric embedding columns found.")
  X
}

chao1 <- function(type_ids) {
  tab <- table(type_ids)
  S_obs <- length(tab)
  f1 <- sum(tab == 1)
  f2 <- sum(tab == 2)

  if (f2 > 0) {
    S_hat <- S_obs + (f1^2) / (2 * f2)
  } else {
    ## Bias-corrected when f2=0 (common in small samples)
    S_hat <- S_obs + (f1 * (f1 - 1)) / 2
  }
  list(S_obs = S_obs, f1 = f1, f2 = f2, S_chao1 = as.numeric(S_hat))
}

rarefy_expected_types <- function(type_ids, m, B = 200) {
  n <- length(type_ids)
  if (n < m) return(NA_real_)
  counts <- numeric(B)
  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample.int(n, size = m, replace = FALSE)
    counts[b] <- length(unique(type_ids[idx]))
  }
  mean(counts)
}


cluster_individual_types <- function(X_ind,
                                     min_cluster_sz = 3,
                                     q_assign = 0.99,
                                     tau_one_type = 0.08,
                                     one_type_quant = 0.95,
                                     noise_policy = c("one_extra", "ignore", "singleton"),
                                     eps = 1e-12) {
  noise_policy <- match.arg(noise_policy)

  n <- nrow(X_ind)
  if (n == 0) return(list(type_ids = character(0), n_clusters = 0))
  if (n == 1) return(list(type_ids = "C1", n_clusters = 1))

  ## L2-normalize for cosine geometry
  norms <- sqrt(rowSums(X_ind^2))
  norms[norms < eps] <- 1
  Xn <- X_ind / norms

  ## Cosine distance matrix
  Dmat <- 1 - tcrossprod(Xn)
  diag(Dmat) <- 0

  ## ---- Conservative "one type" fallback ----
  dvec <- Dmat[upper.tri(Dmat)]
  if (length(dvec) > 0) {
    d_q <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(dvec, probs = one_type_quant, names = FALSE))
    if (is.finite(d_q) && d_q <= tau_one_type) {
      return(list(type_ids = rep("C1", n), n_clusters = 1))
    }
  }

  ## If too few points to form a repeated cluster, be conservative
  if (n < min_cluster_sz) {
    ## Conservative choice: call it one type rather than n singletons
    return(list(type_ids = rep("C1", n), n_clusters = 1))
  }

  ## HDBSCAN on cosine distances
  D <- as.dist(Dmat)
  h <- dbscan::hdbscan(D, minPts = min_cluster_sz)
  cl <- h$cluster  ## 0 = noise

  ## If no clusters found: conservative outcome depends on noise_policy
  if (all(cl == 0)) {
    if (noise_policy == "ignore")   return(list(type_ids = rep("C1", n), n_clusters = 1))
    if (noise_policy == "one_extra")return(list(type_ids = rep("C1", n), n_clusters = 1))
    if (noise_policy == "singleton")return(list(type_ids = paste0("S", seq_len(n)), n_clusters = 0))
  }

  clusters <- sort(unique(cl[cl > 0]))

  ## Medoid per cluster
  medoid_idx <- sapply(clusters, function(k) {
    idx <- which(cl == k)
    subD <- Dmat[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
    idx[which.min(rowSums(subD))]
  })
  names(medoid_idx) <- as.character(clusters)

  ## Cutoffs: within-cluster distances to medoid
  cutoffs <- sapply(clusters, function(k) {
    idx <- which(cl == k)
    m   <- medoid_idx[as.character(k)]
    stats::quantile(Dmat[idx, m], probs = q_assign, names = FALSE)
  })
  names(cutoffs) <- as.character(clusters)

  ## Reassign noise to nearest medoid if close enough
  cl2 <- cl
  noise_idx <- which(cl == 0)
  if (length(noise_idx) > 0) {
    for (i in noise_idx) {
      d_to <- Dmat[i, medoid_idx]
      k_best <- clusters[which.min(d_to)]
      if (min(d_to) <= cutoffs[as.character(k_best)]) {
        cl2[i] <- k_best
      }
    }
  }

  ## Remaining noise: apply conservative policy
  still_noise <- which(cl2 == 0)
  if (length(still_noise) > 0) {
    if (noise_policy == "ignore") {
      ## Put them into the dominant cluster (most conservative)
      dom <- as.integer(names(sort(table(cl2[cl2 > 0]), decreasing = TRUE))[1])
      cl2[still_noise] <- dom
    } else if (noise_policy == "one_extra") {
      ## Group all remaining noise as ONE additional type
      cl2[still_noise] <- max(cl2) + 1L
    } else {
      ## Each remaining noise becomes its own singleton type (least conservative)
      ## Keep as 0 for now; we’ll label as S<i> below.
    }
  }

  ## Convert to type IDs
  type_ids <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  type_ids[cl2 > 0] <- paste0("C", cl2[cl2 > 0])
  if (noise_policy == "singleton") {
    idx0 <- which(cl2 == 0)
    type_ids[idx0] <- paste0("S", idx0)
  } else {
    ## no zeros should remain, but just in case:
    type_ids[is.na(type_ids)] <- "C1"
  }

  list(
    type_ids   = type_ids,
    n_clusters = length(unique(type_ids))
  )
}


## -----------------------
## Main loop across species
## -----------------------





all_individual_results <- list()
species_summary <- list()

for (sp in taxa_list) {
  
  if (sp == "Mirafra passerina"){
    next
  }
  
  print(sp)

  
  emb_df  <- read.csv(paste0("Data/embeddings/PerchV2_embeddings_",
                             sp, "_songs.csv"))

  
  print("?????????????")
  emb_df$name  <- emb_df$filename
  
  
  
  emb_df %<>% dplyr::select(-filename)
  

  print("))))))))))))))")

  
  emb_df$name <- sub("\\.WAV.*", "", emb_df$name, ignore.case = TRUE)  # drop final .wav
  print("((((((((((")
  
  
    if (!sp %in%  c("Plocealauda microptera")) {
    emb_df$name <- sub(".* ", "", emb_df$name)
  }
  
  print("===")
  
  emb_df <- emb_df[, !duplicated(colnames(emb_df))]
  
  
  emb_df %<>% filter(name != "KEN2019_1072")
  
  
  
  print("33333333333")
  print(unique(emb_df$name))
  file_key <- emb_df$name
    

  
  if (any(!file_key %in% comparison_meta$file)){
    print(file_key[which(!file_key %in% comparison_meta$file)])
  }
  # Reorder metadata to match the order in the dist object
  meta_ordered <- comparison_meta[match(file_key, comparison_meta$file), ]
  # print(match(file_key, comparison_meta$file))
  # Safety check: all files should have a matching individual
  meta_ordered %<>% filter(!is.na(individual))
  ## 2. Split indices by individual
  

  print("============")
  print(meta_ordered$individual)
  emb_df$name <- meta_ordered$individual
  
  ## Extract embeddings and normalize (cosine-friendly)
  X <- extract_embedding_matrix(emb_df, exclude = c("name"))
  X <- row_l2_normalize(X, eps = eps_norm)

  ## Optional PCA in a shared species space (reduces noise)
  if (use_pca) {
    npc <- min(max_pcs, ncol(X), nrow(X) - 1)
    if (npc >= 2) {
      p <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE, rank. = npc)
      X_use <- p$x  ## n x npc
    } else {
      X_use <- X
    }
  } else {
    X_use <- X
  }

  indiv_ids <- unique(emb_df$name)

  indiv_rows <- vector("list", length(indiv_ids))
  names(indiv_rows) <- indiv_ids

  for (id in indiv_ids) {
    idx <- which(emb_df$name == id)
    X_ind <- X_use[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    Dmat <- 1 - tcrossprod(X_ind)
    d95  <- quantile(Dmat[upper.tri(Dmat)], 0.95)
    
    if (sp == "Mirafra pulpa"){
      
      Mirafra_pulpa_d95 <- c(Mirafra_pulpa_d95, d95)
      
    }
    


    cl_out <- cluster_individual_types(
      X_ind,
      min_cluster_sz = min_cluster_sz,
      q_assign = q_assign
    )

    type_ids <- cl_out$type_ids

    ## Observed & asymptotic (Chao1)
    ch <- chao1(type_ids)

    ## Effort-standardized expected repertoire at m_effort
    S_m <- rarefy_expected_types(type_ids, m = m_effort, B = n_rarefy)

    indiv_rows[[id]] <- data.frame(
      species      = sp,
      individual   = id,
      n_songs      = length(type_ids),
      n_clusters   = cl_out$n_clusters,
      S_obs        = ch$S_obs,
      f1_singleton = ch$f1,
      f2_doubleton = ch$f2,
      S_chao1      = ch$S_chao1,
      S_rarefy_m   = S_m,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
    indiv_res <- do.call(rbind, indiv_rows)
    all_individual_results[[sp]] <- indiv_res
  
  ## --- Species-level summaries (replace your current block) ---
  
  valid_rarefy <- !is.na(indiv_res$S_rarefy_m)
  
  max_rarefy <- if (any(valid_rarefy)) max(indiv_res$S_rarefy_m[valid_rarefy]) else NA_real_
  min_rarefy <- if (any(valid_rarefy)) min(indiv_res$S_rarefy_m[valid_rarefy]) else NA_real_
  mean_rarefy <- if (any(valid_rarefy)) mean(indiv_res$S_rarefy_m[valid_rarefy]) else NA_real_
  
  max_chao1 <- max(indiv_res$S_chao1, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_chao1 <- min(indiv_res$S_chao1, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_chao1 <- mean(indiv_res$S_chao1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ## (Optional) observed repertoire summary too
  max_obs <- max(indiv_res$S_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_obs <- min(indiv_res$S_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_obs <- mean(indiv_res$S_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  species_summary[[sp]] <- data.frame(
    species               = sp,
    n_individuals         = length(unique(indiv_res$individual)),
    m_effort              = m_effort,
  
    ## Effort-standardized repertoire (only those with enough songs)
    n_indiv_ge_m          = sum(valid_rarefy),
    mean_S_rarefy_m       = mean_rarefy,
    min_S_rarefy_m        = min_rarefy,
    max_S_rarefy_m        = max_rarefy,
  
    ## Asymptotic repertoire (Chao1)
    mean_S_chao1          = mean_chao1,
    min_S_chao1           = min_chao1,
    max_S_chao1           = max_chao1,
  
    ## Optional: observed repertoire (raw)
    mean_S_obs            = mean_obs,
    min_S_obs             = min_obs,
    max_S_obs             = max_obs,
  
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

}

individual_results <- do.call(rbind, all_individual_results)
```

```{r}
# compare distances


comparison_meta <- read.csv("Data/comparison_meta - Sheet1.csv")


intra_ind_mean_dist <- function(d, species){
  

  d <- as.dist(d)
  
    ## 1. Get the labels from the dist object and map them to meta$file
  labs <- attr(d, "Labels")            # names of files used to compute the distances
  
  # 2. From each label, remove the final ".wav" and keep the last 'word'
  #    "Mirafra ... KEN2019_1072.WAV_192.wav" -> "KEN2019_1072.WAV_192"
  file_key <- sub("\\.WAV.*", "", labs, ignore.case = TRUE)  # drop final .wav
  
  # print(file_key)
  
  if (species == "Mirafra passerina") {
    inds <- split(seq_along(file_key), file_key)
  }
  
  else{
    
    if (!species %in%  c("Plocealauda microptera")){
      file_key <- sub(".* ", "", file_key) 
    }
     
    
   

    # Reorder metadata to match the order in the dist object
    meta_ordered <- comparison_meta[match(file_key, comparison_meta$file), ]
    # print(match(file_key, comparison_meta$file))
    # Safety check: all files should have a matching individual
    meta_ordered %<>% filter(!is.na(individual))
    ## 2. Split indices by individual
    inds <- split(seq_along(labs), meta_ordered$individual)
  }
  
  
  ## 3. Convert dist to matrix for easy subsetting
  D <- as.matrix(d)
  # print(inds)
  ## 4. For each individual, compute mean intra-individual distance
  ind_means <- sapply(inds, function(idx) {
    if (length(idx) < 2) return(NA_real_)  # can't compute a distance with <2 files
    M <- D[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
    mean(M[upper.tri(M)])                  # mean of all pairwise distances
  })

  return(ind_means)
}

# bootstrap comparison


delta_bca_onepair <- function(df, sp1, sp2, R){

  d2 <- df %>%
    filter(Species %in% c(sp1, sp2),
           !is.na(Species), !is.na(Similarity)) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c(sp1, sp2)))

  ns <- table(d2$Species)

  # statistic: mean(sp1) - mean(sp2)
  stat_fun <- function(data, indices){
    dd <- data[indices, ]
    m1 <- mean(dd$Similarity[dd$Species == sp1], na.rm = TRUE)
    m2 <- mean(dd$Similarity[dd$Species == sp2], na.rm = TRUE)
    m1 - m2
  }

  b <- boot(
    data = d2,
    statistic = stat_fun,
    R = R,
    strata = d2$Species       # stratified bootstrap within species
  )

  # BCa CI can fail if jackknife unstable (often when ns < 2)
  ci <- tryCatch(
    boot.ci(b, type = "bca")$bca[4:5],
    error = function(e) c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
  )

  list(
    delta_hat = b$t0,
    bca_low   = ci[1],
    bca_high  = ci[2],
    boot_t    = b$t
  )
}

  pairs[,1], pairs[,2],
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)

)

  stat_fun <- function(data, indices){
    dd <- data[indices, ]
    m1 <- mean(dd$Similarity[dd$Species == sp1], na.rm = TRUE)
    m2 <- mean(dd$Similarity[dd$Species == sp2], na.rm = TRUE)
    m1 - m2
  }

  b <- boot(
    data = d2,
    statistic = stat_fun,
    R = R,
    strata = d2$Species       # stratified bootstrap within species
  )

  # BCa CI can fail if jackknife unstable (often when ns < 2)
  ci <- tryCatch(
    boot.ci(b, type = "bca")$bca[4:5],
    error = function(e) c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
  )

  list(
    delta_hat = b$t0,
    bca_low   = ci[1],
    bca_high  = ci[2],
    boot_t    = b$t
  )
}




df <- comparison_within_df_birdnet %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), !is.na(Similarity)) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species))

species <- levels(df$Species)

colnames(pairs) <- c("sp1","sp2")

# compute BCa + store bootstrap replicates per pair
pair_res <- mapply(
  function(a,b) delta_bca_onepair(df, a, b, R = R),
  pairs[,1], pairs[,2],

)

# build results table

  sp1 = pairs[,1],
  sp2 = pairs[,2],
  pair = paste(pairs[,1], pairs[,2], sep=" vs "),
  delta_hat = sapply(pair_res, `[[`, "delta_hat"),
  bca_low   = sapply(pair_res, `[[`, "bca_low"),
  bca_high  = sapply(pair_res, `[[`, "bca_high")
)

# bootstrap p-values from same replicates
boot_mat <- sapply(pair_res, `[[`, "boot_t")

p_raw <- apply(boot_mat, 2, function(x){
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  2 * min(mean(x <= 0), mean(x >= 0))
})

delta_ci_birdnet$p_raw  <- p_raw
delta_ci_birdnet$p_holm <- p.adjust(p_raw, method="holm")
delta_ci_birdnet$sig_holm <- delta_ci_birdnet$p_holm < 0.05
```

# Between individuals
```{r}

between_ind_pair_means <- function(d, species) {
  
  
  d <- as.dist(d)
  
  
  labs <- attr(d, "Labels")
  
  file_key <- sub("\\.WAV.*", "", labs, ignore.case = TRUE)
      
    if (!species %in%  c("Plocealauda microptera")){
      file_key <- sub(".* ", "", file_key) 
    }
     
  file_key <- trimws(file_key)
  meta_ordered <- comparison_meta[match(file_key, comparison_meta$file), ]
  
  keep <- !is.na(meta_ordered$individual)
  meta_ordered <- meta_ordered[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  labs <- labs[keep]
  
  inds <- split(seq_along(labs), meta_ordered$individual)
  
  D <- as.matrix(d)
  D <- D[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  ind_names <- names(inds)
  pairs <- combn(ind_names, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  out <- lapply(pairs, function(p) {
    i <- p[1]; j <- p[2]
    idx_i <- inds[[i]]
    idx_j <- inds[[j]]
    data.frame(
      ind1 = i,
      ind2 = j,
      mean_between = mean(D[idx_i, idx_j, drop = FALSE])
    )
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

between_file_pair_means_within_irruption <- function(d,
                                                    independent,
                                                    irruption_col = "irruption",
                                                    file_col = "name",
                                                    na_rm = TRUE) {
  # Accept matrix or dist
  d <- as.dist(d)
  labs <- attr(d, "Labels")

  # --- Parse labels to file keys, KEEPING ".WAV" ---
  file_key <- sub("(\\.WAV).*", "\\1", labs, ignore.case = TRUE)
  file_key <- trimws(file_key)
  

  # --- Match metadata to matrix order ---
  meta_ordered <- independent[match(file_key, independent[[file_col]]), , drop = FALSE]

  # Keep only rows that matched AND have irruption info
  keep <- !is.na(meta_ordered[[file_col]]) & !is.na(meta_ordered[[irruption_col]])
  meta_ordered <- meta_ordered[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  file_key <- file_key[keep]

  # Similarity matrix in filtered order
  D <- as.matrix(d)
  D <- D[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]

  # --- Stratify by irruption ---
  irr_levels <- unique(meta_ordered[[irruption_col]])
  table(meta_ordered[[irruption_col]])
  out_all <- lapply(irr_levels, function(L) {

    idx_L <- which(meta_ordered[[irruption_col]] == L)
    if (length(idx_L) < 2) return(NULL)

    D_L <- D[idx_L, idx_L, drop = FALSE]
    keys_L <- file_key[idx_L]  # may contain repeats

    # group recording indices by file_key (i.e., by individual)
    inds_L <- split(seq_along(keys_L), keys_L)
    key_names <- names(inds_L)

    if (length(key_names) < 2) return(NULL)

    pairs <- combn(key_names, 2, simplify = FALSE)

    do.call(rbind, lapply(pairs, function(p) {

      i <- p[1]; j <- p[2]
      idx_i <- inds_L[[i]]
      idx_j <- inds_L[[j]]

      vals <- D_L[idx_i, idx_j, drop = FALSE]

      data.frame(
        irruption = L,
        ind1 = i,
        ind2 = j,
        mean_between = mean(vals, na.rm = T),
        n_pairs = length(idx_i) * length(idx_j),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
    
    
  })

  do.call(rbind, out_all)
}

# ---- helper: compute node-bootstrap mean for one species ----
mean_node_boot_one_species <- function(df_sp, R){
  print(unique(df_sp$Species))
  
  if (unique(df_sp$Species) == "Mirafra williamsi"){
    return(
      
      data.frame(
    Species  = "Mirafra williamsi",
    mean     = mean(df_sp$Similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    bca_low  = NA,
    bca_high = NA
  )
    )
  }

  # list individuals in this species
  ids <- sort(unique(c(df_sp$ind1, df_sp$ind2)))
  id_df <- data.frame(ind = ids)

  # statistic: resample individuals -> weighted mean of dyads
  stat_fun <- function(id_data, indices){

    sampled_ids <- id_data$ind[indices]
    mult <- table(sampled_ids)  # multiplicity of each individual

    # weights for each dyad = mult(ind1) * mult(ind2)
    w1 <- mult[as.character(df_sp$ind1)]
    w2 <- mult[as.character(df_sp$ind2)]
    w  <- as.numeric(w1) * as.numeric(w2)
    w[is.na(w)] <- 0

    if(sum(w) == 0) return(NA_real_)

    weighted.mean(df_sp$Similarity, w, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  b <- boot(
    data = id_df,
    statistic = stat_fun,
    R = R
  )
  
  print("stuff")

  ci <- boot.ci(b, type = "bca")

  data.frame(
    Species  = unique(df_sp$Species),
    mean     = mean(df_sp$Similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    bca_low  = ci$bca[4],
    bca_high = ci$bca[5]
  )
}



# bootstrap pairwise delta

delta_bca_node_onepair <- function(df, sp1, sp2, R){

  d2 <- df %>%
    filter(Species %in% c(sp1, sp2),
           !is.na(ind1), !is.na(ind2), !is.na(Similarity)) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c(sp1, sp2)))

  # individuals table across both species
  ind_tbl <- d2 %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, ind1, ind2) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(ind1, ind2), values_to = "ind") %>%
    distinct(Species, ind) %>%
    arrange(Species, ind)

  stat_fun <- function(ind_data, indices){

    samp <- ind_data[indices, ]  # stratified resample if we pass strata
    mult_by_sp <- split(samp$ind, samp$Species)
    mult_tabs  <- lapply(mult_by_sp, table)

    # function to compute weighted mean in one species
    wmean_species <- function(sp){
      df_sp <- d2[d2$Species == sp, , drop=FALSE]
      if(nrow(df_sp) == 0) return(NA_real_)

      mult <- mult_tabs[[as.character(sp)]]
      if(is.null(mult)) return(NA_real_)

      w1 <- mult[as.character(df_sp$ind1)]
      w2 <- mult[as.character(df_sp$ind2)]
      w  <- as.numeric(w1) * as.numeric(w2)
      w[is.na(w)] <- 0

      if(sum(w) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      weighted.mean(df_sp$Similarity, w, na.rm=TRUE)
    }

    m1 <- wmean_species(sp1)
    m2 <- wmean_species(sp2)

    m1 - m2
  }

  b <- boot(
    data = ind_tbl,
    statistic = stat_fun,
    R = R,
    strata = ind_tbl$Species   # <-- key: resample individuals within species
  )

  ci <- tryCatch(boot.ci(b, type="bca")$bca[4:5],
                 error = function(e) c(NA_real_, NA_real_))

  list(delta_hat = b$t0, bca_low = ci[1], bca_high = ci[2], boot_t = b$t)
}
```

# Spectrogram panels
```{r}

irruption_spectrogram_list <- list()


set.seed(36)

song_index <- as.numeric(sample(as.character(c(which(independent$symbol == alphabet[2]))), 1))



for (i in 1:length(unique(independent$irruption))) {

    song_index <- as.numeric(sample(as.character(c(which(independent$symbol == alphabet[i]))), 1))

  spectro <- plot_spectro(song_index) 
  p <- ggplot_build(spectro)
  max_x <- max(p$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x$continuous_range)
  spectro <- spectro +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max_x, by = 0.2),
                       expand = expansion(mult = 0.1))

  
  g <- make_glyph(circle,label = independent$symbol[song_index], fill = independent$color[song_index], text_col = "white", size = 24,
                  text_size = 18)
  
  
  spectro <- ggdraw(spectro) +
    draw_grob(g, x = 0.05, y = 0.825, width = 0.1, height = 0.1)


  irruption_spectrogram_list[[i]] <- spectro
  
  
}


irruption_spectrogram_list_1 <- irruption_spectrogram_list[1:24]

irruption_spectrogram_list_2 <- irruption_spectrogram_list[25:48]


spectro_panel_1 <- wrap_plots(irruption_spectrogram_list_1, ncol = 3)


ggsave("figures/spectro_panel_1.tif",
       spectro_panel_1, width = 4000,
       height = 6000,
       units = "px")

ggsave("figures/spectro_panel_2.tif",
       spectro_panel_2, width = 4000,

       units = "px")
```

```{r}


  paths <- c("ML275310_song_sample.wav",
             "Mopani_Area_1031_song_sample.wav",
             "Sirheni_1039_song_sample.wav")

for (i in 1:3) {
  

  
  file <- readWave(paths[i])
  
  
  # print("sssss")
  # time <- songs$end[songs$name ==
  #                     songs_mean$name[song_index]][num] - songs$begin[songs$name ==
  #                                                                       songs_mean$name[song_index]][num]
  # 
  # band pass filter
  print("stufffff")
  
  file <- fir(wave = file,
              from = 1000, # lower bound frequency in Hz
              to = 4500, # upper bound frequency in Hz
              bandpass = TRUE,
              output = "Wave")
  
  v <- spectro(wave = file, plot = F,
                  wl = 512, # window length (determines frequency resolution)
                  ovlp = 90, # percentage window overlap
                   # sets amplitude threshold and gradient levels for color
                  flim = c(0, 5),
                  colgrid = "gray", # makes the background grid gray,
                  palette=grad, # makes the signal traces black & white,
                  scale = F)$amp
  print("rrrrrrr")
  s <- spectro(wave = file,  plot = F,
               main = "",
               wl = 512, # window length (determines frequency resolution)
               ovlp = 90, # percentage window overlap
               collevels = seq(min(v)/6,0,1), # sets amplitude threshold and gradient levels for color
               flim = c(0, 5),
               colgrid = "gray", # makes the background grid gray,
               palette=grad, # makes the signal traces black & white,
               scale = F, 
               flab = "",
               tlab = "", cex.axis = 1)

  
  # s$amp is a time x frequency matrix, s$time and s$freq are the axes
  s_df <- melt(s$amp, varnames = c("freq_idx", "time_idx"), value.name = "amp")
  s_df$time <- s$time[s_df$time_idx]
  s_df$freq <- s$freq[s_df$freq_idx]
  

  
  
  # original regular grid
  x <- s$time                 # time (cols of s$amp)
  y <- s$freq                 # freq (rows of s$amp)
  z <- t(s$amp)               # your dB matrix (freq x time)
  
  g <- akima::bicubic.grid(x, y, z, nx = 1000, ny = 1000)  # no extrapolation
  
  dim(z)
  
  df_hi <- data.frame(
    expand.grid(time = g$x, freq = g$y),
    amp = as.vector(g$z)
  )
  
  
  # set your dynamic range in dB
  dyn_range <- min(s_df$amp)/6  
  
  
  gg_spectro <- ggplot(df_hi, aes(x = time, y = freq, fill = amp)) +
    geom_raster(interpolate = T, show.legend = F) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.025, 0.025)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white",
      high = "black",
      limits = c(dyn_range, dyn_range/2), 
      oob = scales::squish          # squish values outside into the range
    ) + theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.ontop = TRUE,
      panel.background = element_rect(linewidth = 0.25, fill = NA, colour = "black"),# <- put grid on top of geoms
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = alpha("black", 0.1)),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1.5,
                                 margin = margin(t = -10)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                 margin = margin(l = 0, r = -10)),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(-0.05, "cm"),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
      margins = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
      ) + labs(y = "Frequency (kHz)", x = "Time (s)")
  


  ggsave(paste0(paths[i], ".png"), 
         units = "px",
         height = 1000,
         width = length(s_df$time)/100)

  
}

  
```
